stories.title: Man reaches police outpost with knife lodged in back:Victim alleges bikers attacked him; sub-inspector took bribe but took no action
stories.summary: A young man arrived at a police outpost in Ballia on Wednesday morning with a knife lodged in his back, claiming he had been attacked by bike-borne assailants. He alleged that the attackers stabbed him in the back before fleeing. The victim further claimed he had complained about threats earlier, but no action was taken. According to the young man, he had been facing harassment for the past 15 days and had repeatedly approached the police. He alleged that the outpost in-charge accepted a bribe and failed to act on his complaints. When he reached the Hanumanganj police outpost, the blade was completely embedded in his back, with only the handle visible. A video of the incident has also surfaced. Now know the complete matter Thana Sukhpura area resident Ritesh Tiwari (45), who lives in Jeerabasti, is a stamp vendor at the registry office. On Wednesday morning, he had gone to the court. The distance from his village to the court is about 3 kilometers. Ritesh was returning from there around 9 am. On the way, near Devkali village, a bike rider coming from behind stabbed him in the back with a knife. Before he could understand anything, the bike rider had fled. Attack 500 meters away from police post In an injured condition, Ritesh reached Hanumanganj police post located 500 meters from the incident site. The knife was stuck in his back. Upon arriving here, he complained to the police personnel present. Ritesh said - A bike-riding criminal has attacked me. It is the result of the post in-charge's negligence that a life-threatening attack was made on me today. Ritesh was sent to the district hospital in critical condition. After primary treatment here, he was referred to Trauma Center Varanasi, where his treatment is ongoing. ASP South Sanjay Kumar Verma said - A person has been stabbed by a bike-borne miscreant. Police have taken 2 suspects into custody. They are being interrogated. There is an ongoing dispute between both parties over land. Action will be taken against the accused who carried out the attack. Station House Officer Ratnesh Dubey said- Chowki in-charge Adarsh Shrivastava has been transferred. Currently, the chowki is being operated from the police station itself. On July 4, Ritesh's brother had filed a case against Parvind Tiwari and 4 others for assault and causing injury. The investigation is ongoing. Meanwhile, 4 cases are also registered against Ritesh at the Kotwali.

stories.title: Woman crushed between 2 government buses:Drivers start moving together; victim dies on spot
stories.summary: A major accident occurred at the roadways bus stand in Hardoi. A woman died after being trapped between two buses. Two buses were parked together at the stand. A woman started to pass between them. Just then, both drivers suddenly moved their respective buses forward. As a result, the woman got trapped between the two. By the time both drivers could understand what was happening, the woman was crushed after being trapped between the buses. Her head burst open while she was standing. After the accident, there was chaos at the scene. People raised an alarm, and then both drivers became aware of the accident. The accident occurred at the roadways bus stand located in the City Kotwali area on Wednesday afternoon around 1:30 PM. Now the full story in detail Neha Singh (32), who lived in Khetui village in the Kotwali Dehat area, worked for a pharma (medicine) company. On Wednesday morning, she left home to attend a company meeting in Bangarmau, Unnao. She was waiting for a bus at the stand. According to eyewitnesses, Neha was sitting at the bus stand. Just then, a bus going to Unnao arrived. Neha got up to catch the bus. She started walking between the Kannauj Depot and Hardoi Depot buses that were already parked at the stand. Just then, the drivers of both buses started them and moved them forward. As a result, Neha got trapped between the front parts of both buses while standing. Neha screamed and shouted, and people rushed After this, Neha started screaming and shouting for help. At this, the people nearby rushed over. They made noise and stopped both drivers, but by then Neha was badly crushed. Her head was caught between the two buses and crushed. People pulled Neha out from between the buses and took her to the medical college, where doctors declared her dead. Upon receiving the information, the police arrived and sent the body for post-mortem. Meanwhile, upon hearing the news of his sister-in-law's death, Neha's brother-in-law, Vireesh Singh, reached the spot. He alleges that the accident happened due to the negligence of both bus drivers. Without checking whether anyone was present in front, both buses were moved forward simultaneously. Husband also died in a similar way Vireesh said - Sister-in-law Neha was working to manage the family responsibilities. 10 years ago, my brother (Neha's husband) Sarvesh Singh also died in an accident. He also died after being trapped between a DCM and a truck. He has a 15-year-old daughter, Riya Singh, and an 11-year-old son, Vivek. After the accident, both children became orphans.

stories.title: VIDEO shows guards beating 15-year-old in Lucknow:Police bring him to hospital for medical; Deputy CM seeks report
stories.summary: A 15-year-old boy was allegedly assaulted by security guards at Balrampur Hospital in Lucknow. A video of the incident has surfaced, showing the guards allegedly beating the child, triggering outrage. After the video came to light, the matter reached the health department. Deputy Chief Minister and Health Minister Brajesh Pathak took cognisance of the incident and ordered an inquiry. He has sought a detailed report from the hospital administration, and further action will be taken based on the findings. Incident at 6:30 AM, police brought him to the hospital for medical examination According to information, at two o'clock in the night, police brought a total of 5 people from Madayganj police outpost for medical examination. Medical examination of 2 of them was done, while 3 were left because of lack of papers. Police left them even in the emergency. Meanwhile, in the morning, these three had a dispute with EMO Dr. Surur Ali over some matter. After this, when the guards arrived at the scene, the argument escalated. Soon, a fight broke out. Instructions to submit investigation report in 3 days The Deputy CM posted on X and informed that he has instructed the Director General, Medical and Health, to personally visit the spot and investigate the matter, considering its seriousness. He has also asked to take action against the culprits and submit the investigation report within three days. He wrote that taking cognizance of the video related to the assault at Balrampur Hospital, Lucknow, orders have been given to the Director General, Medical and Health, to investigate the matter. After the investigation, action will be taken against the culprits and the report will have to be submitted within three days. CCTV footage is being reviewed Dr. Vivek Gupta, Director of Balrampur Hospital, stated regarding this matter that CCTV footage is being reviewed concerning the incident. Investigation orders have also been issued by the government. A report will be prepared based on an impartial investigation and then sent to the government. Efforts will be made to complete the investigation before the stipulated time.

stories.title: ‘Students are worried about their future,’ says Shankaracharya:Sant claims India is heading towards dictatorship; cow protection fight to continue
stories.summary: Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand's Gavishth Yatra, which started 81 days ago from Gorakhpur Rural, concluded today. Speaking to the media in a marriage hall in Ramjanki Nagar, Shankaracharya said- The country is moving towards dictatorship. Now the government wants to turn it into North Korea. Students are worried about their future. He said- Even the programs scheduled for July 24 in Lucknow were attempted to be stopped at the administrative level. I have told my army to organise programs in the assemblies, but I will participate in the program at the scheduled time and place. He said- CM Yogi has respected neither religion nor the constitution. Namaz has never been offered on the stairs of Hanumangarhi. He told a blatant lie. When he reached Ayodhya, he said- I will make everything clear. But he could not do it. When he went again, he fabricated a false story. It should be noted that he started his journey on May 3, 2026, from Gorakhpur Rural assembly constituency, demanding that 'Gau Mata' (Cow Mother) be declared the 'Rashtra Mata' (Mother of the Nation). The journey concluded on July 21 upon reaching Gorakhpur city. 5 Big Statements by Shankaracharya The movement will continue until a complete ban on cow slaughter nationwide Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand said - This journey was not just a religious event, but a campaign for national consciousness. In 81 days, millions of people supported it, and the message of cow protection reached across the country. He reiterated that until 'Gau Mata' (Mother Cow) is given the status of 'Rashtramata' (Mother of the Nation) and a complete ban on cow slaughter is imposed nationwide, his movement will continue. Youth are fighting not for any party, but for their future Shankaracharya commented on the students' protest and police action at Jantar Mantar in Delhi. He said - the youth of the country are concerned about their future. He stated that students are protesting not for any political party or organization, but to secure their future. He said - if anyone guarantees their future, the youth will stand with them. Therefore, this movement should not be linked to any single party or organization. He said - during the protest, he witnessed a scene where police and security forces stood with weapons in front of students marching towards Parliament. Calling it a matter of concern for democracy, he said that just as students were dealt with strictly, common citizens might also be treated similarly in the future. In a democracy, the voice of protest should be answered with dialogue, not with the use of force. Danger of North Korea-like situation arising Shankaracharya said - Efforts are being made to suppress the voices of dissent in the country. Pressure is increasing on democratic institutions and action is being taken against those who protest. He said - If this situation continues, the day is not far when India's situation will become like North Korea. He called it a serious threat to democratic values. The administration stopped the July 24 program Shankaracharya said - The resolution ceremony of his Ashirvani Sena was proposed in Lucknow on July 24. For this, the ground fee had been deposited almost a month in advance, and an application for permission had also been sent to the administration 15 days prior. Despite this, permission has not been granted till date. He said - This is not just a matter of administrative procedure, but a deliberate attempt to sabotage his program. Whereas, in a democratic system, stopping a religious-social program in this manner is not appropriate. Supporters were threatened Shankaracharya said - During the Gavishthi Yatra, continuous administrative pressure was exerted. Those who expressed a desire to host him at their homes or offer support were threatened. Notices were issued against his supporters in many places. The administration made every possible effort to prevent the yatra from being successful, but despite this, public support continued to grow. He said- After not getting permission, he has instructed his Ashirwani Sena that all workers should organize 'Sankalp' (pledge) programs in their respective constituencies. Meanwhile, he himself will reach Lucknow on July 24 at the scheduled time and place to address his supporters. He said that the movement will not stop due to any administrative restrictions.

stories.title: 'Congress, SP first incited farmers, now students':Yogi says Oppn believes in unrest, hooliganism; accuses them of spreading lies
stories.summary: Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath targeted the Samajwadi Party (SP) and Congress during an event in Gorakhpur, accusing them of misleading farmers earlier and now trying to provoke students. He claimed the Opposition was running protests as part of a conspiracy to defame students. He also alleged that SP and Congress supporters had surrounded Parliament in Delhi and accused both parties of spreading a false narrative. According to him, their strategy was to repeat lies until they appeared to be true, adding that such narratives must be exposed. Addressing a conference of booth presidents from Gorakhpur city and rural Assembly constituencies at the Yogiraj Baba Gambhirnath Auditorium on Wednesday, the Chief Minister gave election tips to 892 booth presidents ahead of the upcoming polls. Congress and SP glorified Jinnah Yogi claimed that during the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, the Opposition spread misinformation in society. He alleged that Congress falsely promised to give ₹1 lakh and that SP and Congress created a misleading narrative on reservation. He said leaders such as Dr B R Ambedkar, Maharishi Valmiki and Sant Ravidas received due respect under the leadership of Prime Minister Narendra Modi and the BJP government. The Chief Minister added that Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel, who made a significant contribution to the nation, was also honoured by the BJP government through the construction of the world's tallest statue. He alleged that Congress and SP glorified Muhammad Ali Jinnah instead of recognising leaders such as Patel and Ambedkar. Booth presidents must expose Opposition's conspiracy Yogi urged booth presidents to remain alert, claiming that Congress and SP could once again try to create confusion in society, as they allegedly did during the 2024 elections. He asked party workers to expose what he described as the Opposition's misinformation campaign at the booth level. He also asked them to take the government's development and welfare schemes to every household and maintain regular contact with people. The Chief Minister invited those present to Thursday's inauguration of the six-lane flyover in Gorakhpur and encouraged them to visit the structure, take selfies and share them on social media. The booth that wins also wins the election Calling the booth the most important organisational unit, Yogi repeated Prime Minister Modi's slogan, Mera Booth Sabse Majboot (My Booth is the Strongest). He said elections are ultimately won at the booth level, not in the state, district or constituency. According to him, the booth with stronger public support and greater outreach is the one that secures victory. BJP will form government in Uttar Pradesh for a third term The Chief Minister compared booth workers to soldiers guarding the country's borders, saying their alertness helps the BJP form governments at both the Centre and in the state. He expressed confidence that the BJP would return to power in Uttar Pradesh for a third consecutive term in the 2027 Assembly elections. He also congratulated booth presidents for their full attendance at the conference. No one dies of hunger now, 80 crore people get free ration Yogi said India's image had improved globally under Prime Minister Modi's leadership and that the country was now viewed with respect and trust. He said welfare schemes such as housing, Ayushman Bharat, free ration and free LPG connections had reached every eligible beneficiary without discrimination. According to him, 80 crore people across India and 16 crore people in Uttar Pradesh are receiving free ration. The Chief Minister alleged that people died of hunger under previous governments and referred to reports of Musahar community members dying of starvation in Kushinagar. He also recalled former Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi's statement that only ₹15 out of every ₹100 sent by the government reached the poor, saying the current government has ensured full transparency through Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT). Nine lakh government jobs given transparently Yogi said his government had provided nine lakh government jobs through a transparent recruitment process, claiming there was no recommendation, favouritism or bribery involved. He also alleged that during the SP government, recruitment for SDM posts had favoured a particular caste. The Chief Minister said that before 2017, young people from Gorakhpur and Uttar Pradesh were looked down upon, but today they receive respect wherever they go. He added that the BJP government had also preserved the state's cultural and religious heritage by constructing the Ram Temple in Ayodhya, redeveloping the Kashi Vishwanath Corridor and Vindhyachal Dham, and promoting the Naimisharanya pilgrimage site. In previous governments, deaths occurred due to hunger, now 80 crore people receive free ration In the Booth Presidents' Conference, Yogi also elaborated on the conceptual changes, development works, and public welfare that have come about in the BJP's double-engine government in the country and the state. He said that under the leadership of PM Modi, the world's perception of India has changed. Now India is seen not with suspicion, but with respect and trust. In the double-engine government, the benefits of poor welfare schemes have reached the person at the last rung of society without discrimination. The benefits of schemes related to housing, Ayushman, free ration, and free cooking gas have been ensured to reach every eligible person. He said that 80 crore people in the country and 16 crore people in the state are getting the facility of free ration. Whereas in previous governments, the poor died of hunger. Due to the failure of previous governments, many Musahars died of hunger in Kushinagar. The Chief Minister said that during the Congress government, their own Prime Minister Rajiv Gandhi had admitted that out of 100 rupees sent by the government, only 15 rupees reached the poor. Whereas the double engine government has ensured 100 per cent transparency in providing scheme benefits to the poor through DBT. 9 lakh youths received government jobs with transparency CM Yogi also mentioned the unprecedented development and employment in the state and Gorakhpur. He said that his government has provided government jobs to 9 lakh youths with complete transparency. There was no recommendation, no 'jugaad' (improvisation/fix), and no money involved. Whereas during the SP government, the maximum number of SDM recruitments were made in the name of a particular caste. He said that before 2017, the youth of Gorakhpur, UP were looked down upon. But today, when the youth here go out, they are respected by others. He said that the BJP government also respected the heritage. A grand temple of Lord Shri Ram was built in Ayodhya. Kashi Vishwanath and Vindhyachal Dham were beautified, and the Naimisharanya pilgrimage site was developed. Everyone invited to the inauguration ceremony of the six-lane flyover The Chief Minister, calling the six-lane flyover a major achievement in the development of Gorakhpur, invited everyone to its inauguration ceremony on Thursday. He said, "Come to this biggest flyover in Gorakhpur, take a selfie, and share it on social media." The conference commenced with floral tributes to the portraits of Dr. Syama Prasad Mookerjee and Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya, followed by the collective singing of Vande Mataram. The booth presidents' conference was also addressed by MP Ravi Kishan Shukla, Mayor Dr. Manglesh Srivastava, MLA of Gorakhpur Rural Assembly constituency Vipin Singh, BJP State Vice President and MLC Dr. Dharmendra Singh, and Regional President Vinod Rai. Welcoming Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath at the conference, BJP Metropolitan President Ramesh Pratap Gupta presented the program's introduction. On this occasion, former Metropolitan President Rajesh Gupta, Metropolitan Vice President Shashikant Singh, General Secretaries Achyutanand Shahi, Omprakash Sharma, Minister Ajay Srivastava, Regional Media In-charge Dr. Baccha Pandey, Naveen, Metropolitan Media In-charge Chandan Arya, other office bearers of the Metropolitan unit, and presidents of 457 booths from Gorakhpur City Assembly constituency and 435 booths from Gorakhpur Rural Assembly constituency were present.

stories.title: Man kills his mother for ₹5 lakh aid:Sat beside body and shed crocodile tears, blamed leopard for attack
stories.summary: In Bijnor, what the family initially believed to be a leopard attack turned out to be murder. A 70-year-old woman was killed by her own younger son by strangulation. According to police, lured by the compensation of ₹5 lakh given in leopard attack cases, he brutally killed his mother. After the murder, he spread a rumour that a leopard had grabbed his mother by the neck and taken her away. The son told people: I tried to chase away the leopard with a sickle, but couldn't save my mother. The incident occurred on Monday evening around 5 PM. The woman had gone to the field to cut fodder for the cattle. During this time, her younger son raised an alarm and called the villagers, claiming that a leopard had grabbed his mother and taken her away. However, the post-mortem report that came on Tuesday revealed that the woman died due to strangulation. Following this, the police took the son into custody. During interrogation, the son confessed to committing the murder. The case in detail Veeravati Singh (70), a resident of Ajupura Jat village in the Heempur Deepa police station area of Bijnor, lived with her younger son Bahal Singh alias Mania. Veeravati has two sons. The elder son Rup Chand works in Dehradun, while her husband Munne Singh had passed away five years ago. On Monday evening around 5 PM, Veeravati had gone to the forest to collect fodder for the cattle. After some time, her younger son Bahal Singh raised an alarm and called the villagers, claiming that a leopard had dragged his mother away. Veeravati's body was found a short distance away in the field, after which everyone assumed it to be a death caused by a leopard attack. Upon receiving information, teams from the Forest Department, Police, and Revenue Department reached the spot. Angry villagers and family members protested against removing the body. After much persuasion, the police sent the body for post-mortem. Forest Department became suspicious of son's story, postmortem report revealed the truth Meanwhile, the Forest Department team that reached the spot raised questions about the leopard attack in the initial investigation itself. The officials found that there were neither teeth marks on the body nor any clear evidence of claw attacks. No part of the body was torn or eaten. There were only injury marks on the hands and face. The postmortem report that came on Tuesday further confirmed the Forest Department's suspicion. It also changed the direction of the police investigation. In fact, the report revealed that Veervati's death was caused by strangulation. Additionally, marks of several serious injuries were found on the body and ribs were also broken. According to the medical report, heavy pressure was applied to the stomach with a heavy object or knee, which caused internal injuries. After the postmortem report, the police took the younger son, Bahal Singh alias Mania, into custody and started interrogation. CO Chandpur Desh Deepak Singh said that during interrogation, Bahal Singh alias Mania confessed to the murder. The accused told the police that he used to quarrel with his mother every day. On the day of the incident, both had gone to the field to cut grass. There, an argument and exchange of abuses occurred over something. In anger, he strangled his mother and killed her. After this, so that no one would suspect and to get the financial assistance available in case of a leopard attack, he fabricated a false story of a leopard attack. FIR registered on elder son's complaint Police said- Based on the complaint of the deceased's elder son, a case has been registered under relevant sections at Heempur Deepa police station. The accused has been taken into custody and further legal action is being taken.

stories.title: Akhilesh's detention sparks SP protest in Agra:Police forcibly put workers into buses and take them into custody
stories.summary: Police detained Samajwadi Party workers near the Agra Fort on Wednesday. All these workers had gathered to protest against the action taken against party chief Akhilesh Yadav in Delhi a day earlier. Party officials and supporters, including women workers, participated in the demonstration. Even before the protest began, police detained about 50 SP members. All of them were sent to the police line. During this, SP workers raised slogans against the government. In view of the situation, a large number of police personnel were deployed at the Red Fort premises. Police took them into custody and forcibly put them on a bus In protest against the removal and detention of Opposition leaders during protests in Delhi, the Samajwadi Party and Congress are protesting nationwide. As part of this, Samajwadi Party workers gathered for a protest at the Red Fort complex in Agra on Wednesday. Upon receiving information about the protest, a large police contingent was deployed at the fort. As soon as SP workers arrived and started protesting, all of them were taken into custody. All the workers were forcibly put on a bus and sent to the police line. Metropolitan President appealed; women continued to chant slogans During the detention, the SP's metropolitan president appealed to the police with folded hands not to take the workers, but the police did not listen. During this, women workers fiercely chanted slogans against the government. They protested the police action. For some time, an atmosphere of chaos prevailed at the spot. Sloganeering in Police Line In Agra's Police Line, SP workers protested the detention of Akhilesh Yadav and the violence against children in the Delhi protest. They raised slogans against the government. Activists chanted the slogan, 'Where do we madmen go, let's go to jail, brother, let's go to jail.' Additionally, slogans like 'Whenever Yogi gets scared, he puts the police forward' were continuously being raised.

stories.title: Samajwadi Party to oppose Jauhar University demolition:15 MLAs to meet Rampur DM on July 23, MP Mohibullah absent from delegation
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party (SP) will send a delegation to Rampur on Thursday to oppose the proposed demolition of Jauhar University, the dream project of senior party leader Azam Khan. The delegation, led by Uttar Pradesh Leader of Opposition Mata Prasad Pandey, will meet the District Magistrate and submit a memorandum demanding that the demolition drive be halted. The team comprises 15 sitting MLAs, district presidents from Rampur, Moradabad, and Bareilly, along with several former legislators. Move follows Akhilesh Yadav’s directions In a letter issued by state president Shyam Lal Pal, the party said the delegation is being sent on the instructions of SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. The SP argued that demolishing Jauhar University would violate the constitutional spirit and the right to education. According to the party, thousands of students from across the country study at the university at affordable fees. It said any damage to the institution would disproportionately affect students from poor, backward, and Dalit communities. Who is part of the delegation? Apart from Mata Prasad Pandey, the delegation includes MLAs Nasir Ahmed Khan, Kamal Akhtar, Shahid Manzoor, Ataur Rahman, Nawab Jan, Haji Nasir Qureshi, Faheem Irfan, Shahjil Islam Ansari, Rafiq Ansari, Atul Pradhan, Pankaj Malik, Pinki Singh, Iqbal Mahmood, and Ram Khiladi Singh Yadav. Several former MLAs and the district presidents of Rampur, Moradabad, and Bareilly are also part of the delegation. Rampur MP Mohibullah not included Rampur MP Mohibullah Nadvi has not been included in the delegation. The party said no Members of Parliament were included because the ongoing Parliament session would prevent them from participating. However, political observers have also linked his exclusion to the long-running differences between Azam Khan and Mohibullah Nadvi. Why Are Azam Khan and Mohibullah Nadvi at odds? 1. Disagreement over Lok Sabha ticket Ahead of the 2024 Lok Sabha elections, Akhilesh Yadav met Azam Khan in Sitapur Jail. Azam reportedly wanted Akhilesh himself to contest from Rampur, but the party instead fielded Mohibullah Nadvi. The decision allegedly upset Azam Khan, who appealed to his supporters to boycott the election. 2. 'Reform home' remark After becoming an MP, Mohibullah Nadvi said in an interview that Azam Khan was "not in jail but in a reform home." Azam reportedly viewed the remark as a taunt and expressed displeasure over it on several occasions. 3. Refused to recognise him After his release from jail in September 2025, Azam Khan reportedly declined to acknowledge Mohibullah Nadvi when asked about him by journalists. Responding to the incident, Mohibullah said Azam Khan had grown old and may have had difficulty recognising him. He also expressed a desire to meet Azam, but the meeting never took place. 4. Asked not to accompany Akhilesh to Rampur Following Azam Khan's release from jail, Mohibullah Nadvi accompanied Akhilesh Yadav while travelling to meet him in Rampur. However, Azam Khan reportedly objected to his presence. As a result, Mohibullah stayed back in Bareilly, while Akhilesh Yadav continued alone to Rampur to meet the senior SP leader.

stories.title: Life sentence for man who raped minor daughter and daughter-in-law:Firozabad court orders 1 lakh fine in addition to sentence
stories.summary: A local court in Firozabad has sentenced a man to life imprisonment for raping his daughter-in-law and minor daughter. Additionally, a fine of ₹1 lakh has been imposed on him. The court directed that 80 per cent of the fine amount be given equally to both the victims. Fast Track Court Judge Devdatt announced the verdict on Tuesday evening, stating: The convict should be kept in prison until his last breath. If the victim's statement is solid, irrefutable and credible, then the accused can be convicted based on that alone. This case is from a neighbourhood in the Dakshin Thana area. In the year 2024, four members of a family suddenly left their home. After this, the head of the family filed a missing persons report with the police. When the police started investigating, the case turned out to be one of rape. Father was raping daughter and daughter-in-law On May 11, 2024, a 45-year-old man filed a complaint with the police that his wife, son, daughter-in-law and minor daughter had been missing from home since 9 May. The police registered a missing persons case and started the search. About a week later, the family was found in Aligarh. After this, the police interrogated everyone separately. During interrogation, the accused's wife revealed that her husband had been raping his minor daughter and daughter-in-law for the past six months. When she protested, he would threaten to kill her. When she tried to complain, he would lock the entire family inside the house. Fed up with the torture, the family had moved to Aligarh. Accused also took son's name Police recorded statements of both victims. During interrogation, the accused also took his son's name. After this, police also registered a case against the son. After completing the investigation, police filed a chargesheet against both. Son acquitted as charges not proven The case was heard in the court of Additional District and Sessions Judge (Fast Track Court-1) Devdatt. ADGC Manoj Kumar argued on behalf of the prosecution. The defense argued that the victims' medical examination was not conducted, therefore the charges are not proven. The court found the statements of both victims and other evidence credible, convicted the accused father and sentenced him to life imprisonment. The court ordered that he be kept in prison for the remainder of his natural life. However, the accused's son was acquitted due to lack of sufficient evidence.

stories.title: Congress workers march to CM residence with sticks in Lucknow:Protest over BJP demonstration at Congress office, 4-layer barricading deployed
stories.summary: The Congress has given a call to gherao (lay siege) the Chief Minister's residence in Lucknow on Wednesday. Following the BJP's call to gherao the Congress headquarters, Congress State President Ajay Rai called a meeting of workers. After the meeting, Congress workers will set out to gherao the CM residence. Barricades have been put up on all three routes to the Congress headquarters. Four-layer barricading has been done Four-layer barricading was set up near the Waqf Board on the route coming from the VVIP Guest House. Besides this, barricading was also done on the routes going towards the CM residence from Lal Batti Chowk and on the Udayganj route. On Tuesday, the top Congress leadership had gheraoed PM Modi's residence in Delhi. In response to this, BJP had called for gheraoing the Congress headquarters. 'Let's talk about students' rights' Congress leader Ahmed Raza arrived with a welcome poster. The post read 'Come, you are welcome, we will talk about students' rights'. Ahmed said that if the Bharatiya Janata Party comes to our headquarters, we will talk about students' rights and the Constitution. He said that this government does not want dialogue. “In Delhi, our leader Rahul Gandhi also went to PM Narendra Modi's residence so that we could talk about students' rights, we want to do this in Lucknow,” he said.

stories.title: Ayodhya Ram Temple Trust assigns religious duties to 9 saints:Govind Dev Giri to head panel; CEO appointment still pending
stories.summary: The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust took two major decisions at its meeting in Ayodhya on Wednesday. The first was the formation of a 9-member religious committee, comprising 5 saints from Ayodhya and four members from the temple trust. Trust Treasurer Swami Govind Dev Giri has been appointed chairman of the committee. The second decision was that the trust will appoint an official spokesperson. A secretary will also be appointed. The meeting was held from 3 pm to 5 pm at Shri Swami Mani Ram Das Chhawani under the chairmanship of Trust President Mahant Nritya Gopal Das Maharaj. No consensus was reached on the appointment of a permanent General Secretary or the Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Krishna Mohan will continue as the Acting General Secretary for now. The next trust meeting will be held on 2 September, when the names of the new General Secretary and CEO are expected to be announced. For the post of General Secretary, Vishwa Hindu Parishad (VHP) General Secretary Bajrang Lal Bangda remains the leading contender. He also attended the meeting. This was the trust's second meeting since the temple donation theft case. At the meeting held on 6 July, the resignations of Champat Rai and Dr Anil Mishra were accepted, and retired IFS officer Krishna Mohan was appointed Acting General Secretary. Champat Rai and Anil Mishra had resigned on 26 June following the donation theft case. Key issues discussed by the Trust Anger over SBI's lapses: The trust had signed an agreement with the State Bank of India (SBI) to handle the counting of donations at the Ram Mandir. However, the individuals deployed by the bank for the counting process were later found to be among the accused in the alleged donation theft case. Saints expressed displeasure over SBI's role. The Finance Committee has been directed to review the entire matter and take necessary decisions. CEO decision deferred by 1-month: The selection process for the new Chief Executive Officer (CEO) to manage the temple's administration is in its final stages. Around 5,200 candidates from across the country have applied online for the post. The selection committee sought an additional 1-month to complete the process, and the trust approved the request. The trust also approved the appointment of a Secretary to meet administrative requirements. Trust to appoint an Official spokesperson: To maintain regular communication with the public and the media, the trust has decided to appoint an official spokesperson. The move aims to ensure timely and authentic dissemination of information related to the temple and the trust. No decline in devotee footfall: The trust said that despite various allegations and what it described as a misinformation campaign, the number of devotees visiting the Ram Mandir has not declined. It said this reflects the unwavering faith of millions of Ram devotees and expressed gratitude to the saint community, devotees, and the people of Ayodhya. Religious committee reconstituted The trust reconstituted its Religious Committee to maintain the traditional purity of worship rituals. Swami Govind Dev Giri will chair the committee. Its members will include Jagadguru Shankaracharya Swami Vasudevanand Saraswati, Swami Vishwaprasannatirtha, Swami Dinendra Das, Swami Kamalnayan Das, Mahant Rajkumar Das, Swami Ramanand Das, and Swami Mithilesh Nandini Sharan. The meeting also reviewed the process of filling vacant trustee positions. The trust expressed hope that the appointments would be completed within the next few weeks. Satisfaction over CCTV arrangements The trustees reviewed the CCTV surveillance system in the temple complex. The trust said security officials have access to all cameras, including those installed in the donation counting room. The trustees expressed satisfaction with the existing surveillance arrangements. SIT report yet to be received The trust said it has not yet received the final report of the SIT probing the alleged irregularities in the counting of donations. As a result, no detailed discussion on the matter could take place. However, the trustees took note of the ongoing proceedings in the Supreme Court and the court's directions.

stories.title: Tripura DGP's final journey in Baghpat:Mother caresses his face, wife hugs body, son devastated; cremation today
stories.summary: Tripura Director General of Police (DGP) Anurag Dhankar will be cremated in Baghpat, Uttar Pradesh on Wednesday. His funeral procession began at 9 am. Earlier, on Tuesday night, when his mortal remains reached his home in Baraut, his mother and wife broke down in grief. Repeating, "My child... my child...", his mother walked up to the body and gently caressed his face one last time. His wife, Kalpana, clung to the body and wept uncontrollably. Their son, Abhishek, tried to console her, but she embraced him and continued crying. Abhishek, who had flown in from Canada, was unable to hold back his emotions. Calling out, "Papa... Papa...", he hugged his father's body and burst into tears. DGP Anurag Dhankar's body was found at the Tripura Police Headquarters on 20 July. According to the preliminary police investigation, he died by suicide. After receiving the information, Anurag's younger brother rushed to Tripura. Baghpat Superintendent of Police Suraj Rai and Additional Superintendent of Police Praveen Kumar Chauhan also travelled to the state. Later, accompanied by senior Tripura Police officials, Dhankar's mortal remains were flown to Delhi by air ambulance and then taken by road to his hometown of Baraut in Baghpat.

stories.title: WATCH | Virat, Anushka walk barefoot to meet Premanand Maharaj:Couple visits Vrindavan to seek blessings 2 days before the Guru Purnima festival
stories.summary: Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma were spotted at Vrindavan this morning on 22 July to meet spiritual leader Premanand Maharaj. As per the visuals, the couple walked barefoot in mud to the premises surrounded by the disciples of Premanand Maharaj near the Kelly Kunj Ashram. The couple arrived early in the morning to meet the revered saint and receive his blessings. Notably, the visit from the couple holds significance since they have arrived at the Ashram two days before the Guru Purnima festival, an occasion on which people honour the spiritual and academic teachers. Wearing face masks, Virat and Anushka were spotted heading straight into the ashram. The couple stayed at the ashram for about an hour. When they came out, Virat had a sandalwood tilak on his forehead and prasad in his hand. They then visited the ashram of Maharaj Ji's guru, Govind Sharan Maharaj, located 150 metres away. They paid their respects and sought his blessings. Earlier, after winning the IPL, Virat and Anushka had visited Sant Premanand in Vrindavan on June 2. The two had stayed at the ashram for two hours. They came out with sandalwood and Tripund tilaks on their foreheads and a book in hand. Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma's 4th Vrindavan visit in 2026 Earlier on 2 June, the couple had visited the ashram after RCB's title win against Gujarat Titans in the IPL 2026 final match. Before that, on 20 April, coinciding with the occasion of Akshaya Tritiya, the couple had also visited Premanand Maharaj’s ashram, where they attended a satsang and sought his blessings. Their repeated visits reflect their continued spiritual association with the saint and his teachings. What is Guru Purnima festival? Guru Purnima is a revered festival celebrated on the full moon day (Purnima) of the Hindu lunar month of Ashadha (June–July) to honour spiritual and academic teachers. It is deeply rooted in Hindu, Buddhist, and Jain traditions and takes place on Wednesday, July 29, 2026. Virat Kohli scored two half-centuries in the ODI series against England The star cricketer recently appeared in the ODI series against England that India lost 2-1. However, Kohli performed well with the bat, hitting two half-centuries in the three games. In the first game, he got out early for 5, but in the next two matches, Virat made a spectacular comeback. He scored 65(66) and 74(60) in the rest of the two one-day matches. When will Virat appear again in one-day? Virat's next one-day appearance will be against West Indies, which is set to be a home series starting in September. It is a three-match ODI series, which is part of the West Indies Tour of India, with the first match set to be played in Trivandrum Virat and Anushka’s eighth visit to Premanand Maharaj Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma recently paid their eighth visit to spiritual leader Premanand Maharaj. The couple first met him on 4 January 2023, and have continued to visit his ashram regularly. Over the past three years, this marks their eighth meeting and their fourth visit in 2026. Earlier in 2025, they visited thrice in a year.

stories.title: Children fall ill during monsoon in Gorakhpur:High-grade fever cases rise at district hospital; doctors advise extra caution
stories.summary: In Gorakhpur, children's illnesses are rapidly increasing with the changing weather. Dr. Ganesh Gaurav, Child Specialist at the District Hospital, reported that since the beginning of July, the number of patients with cold-cough, stomach pain, vomiting-diarrhoea, and high-grade fever in the OPD has increased by up to 10 per cent. He says that bacteria spread rapidly during the rainy season, which easily increases the problem of infections. The months of June-July are called infected months. During these months, all kinds of germs breed and are spread in the environment. The doctor explained that the skin of children from zero to 15 years is quite sensitive. Additionally, their immunity power is also weaker compared to adults. In such a situation, protecting them from their diet and the effects of weather during the rainy season becomes extremely important. Otherwise, even a small negligence can become a cause of major trouble. 60 to 70 patients with seasonal problems reach the OPD daily Dr Gaurav said that for the past few days, around 100 to 120 patients have been coming to the Child OPD. Out of these, 60 to 70 are completely new cases with fever, cold-cough, runny nose, vomiting-diarrhoea, and stomach pain. The patients include children from 0 to 15 years of age. The most problems are being seen in children up to 5 years of age. He said that during the rainy season, infections increase due to bacteria remaining active and rapidly growing anywhere. Why is illness increasing Small children, while playing at home or outside, unknowingly touch infected objects. Then they eat food or other things with the same hand. Now the germs hidden in the hands easily enter the stomach, and diseases start from there. He informed that more patients with high-grade fever and vomiting-diarrhoea are reaching the OPD. In the changing weather, the bad effects of sometimes rain and then sunshine are affecting their health. In such a situation, care must be taken that children should not get wet in the rain at all. Parents should pay special attention The doctor says that in such weather, the responsibility of parents increases. It becomes necessary to take care of everything from eating and drinking to wearing and covering. Even a little negligence can cause big trouble. He said that by following the doctor's precautions when the illness increases and taking small precautions, any patient generally recovers completely within a week. But negligence worsens the situation, and many patients have to be admitted to the emergency. What are the symptoms? The doctor explained that children affected by illness due to weather changes commonly show symptoms such as loss of appetite, lethargy, increased irritability, feeling warm in the body or forehead, frequent vomiting and diarrhoea, nasal congestion, difficulty breathing, and reduced sleep. Take these precautions He also explained preventive measures...

stories.title: Online fraud busted:Gang member arrested for fake gold and counterfeit notes scam; cyber café operator's vigilance exposes racket
stories.summary: In the Bharatpur area of Baragaon police station jurisdiction in Varanasi district, police have busted a gang of cyber fraudsters who were duping people by showing them gold and bundles of notes online. Police arrested one member of the gang late on Tuesday evening, while his two accomplices fled from the scene. Police are engaged in searching for the absconding accused. The case came to light during investigation of a complaint registered on the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal. Ricky Roshan, a cyber cafe operator located in Bharatpur under Baragaon police station, had complained that on 17 July, a suspicious transaction of ₹15,300 had occurred in his bank account. After this, the bank had held and frozen his account. Investigation revealed that on 17 July, a youth had taken cash from the cafe operator by showing online payment through QR code. After that, this action was taken on Ricky's account. Meanwhile, on Tuesday evening around 6 pm, the same youth came to the cyber cafe again and started demanding cash after transferring money online. Upon seeing the young man, the cafe operator recognised him and raised an alarm. Hearing the commotion, people nearby caught him while two other youths who came with him fled from the scene. Sub-Inspector Khushboo Singh from Badagaon police station, who arrived upon receiving information, took the accused into custody along with the police team. During interrogation, the arrested was identified as 40-year-old Alok Singh, a resident of Gopalapur in the Rampur police station area of Jaunpur district. The accused revealed that he, along with his associates Hemant Singh and Satish Singh, would defraud people by showing them gold and bundles of notes online. It is being reported that on 17 July as well, the accused had defrauded a person of ₹85,000 rupees by showing gold online. They had come to the cyber cafe to convert the ₹85,000 rupees obtained from the fraud into cash through the cyber cafe. The police have registered a case against Alok Singh under Section 318(4) of the Indian Penal Code. Meanwhile, the police are continuously conducting raids in search of the absconding accused Hemant and Satish.

stories.title: Sharda rises above danger mark in UP:Floodwaters enter villages; tree crushes biker, rain alert for all 75 districts
stories.summary: Rivers across Uttar Pradesh are in spate after 10 days of continuous rainfall. In Lakhimpur Kheri, the Sharda River is flowing above the danger mark, with floodwaters entering villages along its banks. The situation has become so severe that crocodiles have been spotted roaming on roads and through fields. In Sonbhadra, the road leading to the district jail was washed away after the Ghaghra River swelled. In Varanasi, the Ganga's water level has risen by 10 feet in the past week, submerging around 50 small and large temples between Assi Ghat and Namo Ghat. In Prayagraj, the steps of several ghats have gone under water. Intermittent light rain has been falling in Noida since Wednesday morning. Cloudy skies have been reported in around 50 cities, including Lucknow, Kanpur and Agra, with occasional sunny spells. A rain alert has been issued for all 75 districts of the state today (Wednesday), with heavy rainfall forecast for 10 cities. Earlier, on Tuesday, rain was recorded in 74 districts, including Lucknow and Prayagraj. In Unnao, a tree fell on a moving motorcycle due to strong winds. The rider suffered a broken neck and died on the spot. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said: “The low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal weakened, resulting in heavy rainfall across Uttar Pradesh over the past three to four days. The monsoon trough is now shifting southwards. As a result, some districts may receive heavy rain today, while southern parts of the state could witness very heavy rainfall. Rainfall is expected to ease from tomorrow. After a three-day break, the monsoon will regain momentum from 26 July, and another spell of rain will begin across the state.”

stories.title: Six freight train wagons derail:Accident on Ghaziabad–Delhi route; 16 train services cancelled, 53 affected
stories.summary: Six wagons of a coal-laden freight train derailed on the Ghaziabad–Delhi route in the early hours of Wednesday. The accident occurred at around 2.36 am. On receiving the information, the Railway Divisional Manager (DRM) and other officials rushed to the spot and took stock of the situation. Fortunately, no one was injured. Senior railway officials have ordered an inquiry into the incident. Following the derailment, several train routes have been diverted, with long-distance trains being operated via New Delhi, Sadar Bazar and Old Delhi–Shahdara. Several trains cancelled after derailment Wagons of a coal-laden freight train derailed in Ghaziabad's Sahibabad area, spilling coal onto the tracks and disrupting rail traffic. As a result, several trains had to be cancelled at short notice. The routes of 24 trains running via Delhi and New Delhi have been diverted. Sixteen passenger trains have been cancelled, while five passenger trains have been partially cancelled. The timings of eight trains from the Moradabad Division and the North Central Railway (NCR) heading to Anand Vihar have also been rescheduled. In all, 53 train services have been affected.

stories.title: Akhilesh and Rahul arrested in Delhi:Midnight unrest in Lucknow as police drag away SP, Congress workers; 4 hospitalised
stories.summary: The Samajwadi Party and Congress held a vigorous protest in Lucknow on Tuesday evening. Protesters took to the streets against the arrest of Congress leader Rahul and SP chief Akhilesh Yadav in Delhi. A strong demonstration was held near the Legislative Assembly, Janbhawan and Hazratganj intersection from 7 PM till around midnight. SP workers arrived to protest in groups of 20. They had a sharp confrontation with the police. The police dragged them and took them to Eco Garden. Four workers were admitted to Civil Hospital due to injuries. Earlier in the evening, Congress state president Ajay Rai, who was coming to gherao Janbhawan, was detained by police about 10 kilometers away in the BKT area. He was taken to Eco Garden and released. One hour after Ajay Rai was taken into custody, Congress city committee president Shahzad Alam and other workers reached Janbhawan. SP State President taken into custody In protest against the detention of Samajwadi Party National President Akhilesh Yadav in Delhi, Party State President Shyam Lal Pal reached the Legislative Assembly. He started raising slogans against the government. Police took him into custody from there. During this time, a large number of SP workers reached Hazratganj intersection and started raising slogans. National spokesperson Juhi Singh, Ram Singh Rana along with a large number of workers were taken into custody from Atal Chowk. During this, there was considerable scuffling between workers and police in which the protesters' clothes were torn. SP workers also staged protest at Janbhawan Around 8:15 PM, a large number of Samajwadi Party workers reached Janbhawan. During this time, the police tried to detain them. After this, SP workers lay down on the ground. The police dragged Pooja Shukla, an SP leader, along with many workers and took them away in a bus. During the protest, there was considerable pushing and shoving. Several workers fell ill SP leader Atul stated that the police beat them brutally, following which Mahendra Yadav, Kanchi, Navneet and Shiva ji were seriously injured. Their treatment continued for a long time at the Civil Hospital. The condition of several party workers is serious, and they will need prolonged treatment. Accused of tearing clothes SP leader Pooja Shukla was dragged away by the police. During this, she said, “We had come to protest. The police misbehaved with the protesters. Clothes were torn. This has not happened for the first time. This always happens. The police are tearing our clothes and we are fighting for their children.” Pictures of Congress's protest 'Rahul Gandhi is struggling in Delhi and we are doing it in Lucknow' Congress workers demanded the resignation of PM Modi and Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Dr. Shahzad, who was protesting, said that this government is continuously violating the rights of students. “On Monday, students were brutally lathi-charged in Delhi and they were injured, this is extremely shameful,” he said. “Our leader Rahul Gandhi is fighting this battle in Delhi and all of us workers are struggling for students in Lucknow,” he said. 'The future of students is becoming dark' Ravi, who participated in the demonstration, said that he is a student. They have come to surround Jan Bhavan today on issues concerning students' interests. Dharmendra Pradhan should immediately resign on the issue of NEET examination and paper leak. “Due to the government's poor attitude, students' future is going into darkness. We do not want to see Dharmendra Pradhan as Education Minister under any circumstances. Our movement will not stop until he resigns,” he said. Congress leader Aryan Mishra and Congress members reached Janbhavan. While raising slogans against the BJP government and Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, they threw ink on PM Modi's picture. Arya said, “This government has pushed students' future into darkness. That's why we are throwing ink on the picture.” “Playing with students' future will not be tolerated. Our leader Rahul Gandhi is continuously struggling. We are also part of the fight with him,” he said.

stories.title: 6 major drawbacks for skipping marriage registration:Lakhs in benefits could be blocked; know the online application process for ₹10
stories.summary: Marriage registration is mandatory in Uttar Pradesh. This is necessary for people of all religions and castes. Without a marriage certificate, many tasks from banking to going abroad can be jeopardised. What is the online and offline process for marriage registration? Residence certificate necessary for arranged marriage Marriage registration in UP is done under the 'Women Welfare Department' and 'Stamp and Registration Department'. Marriage registration will only happen in that tehsil where the groom, bride or their parents have a permanent address. Registration cannot be done based on the place where the marriage took place. If the boy is from UP and the girl is from another state, then the boy's residence certificate will be required while getting the marriage registered. According to the 'Uttar Pradesh Marriage Registration Rules 2017', for marriage registration, the groom's age must be at least 21 years, and the bride's age must be at least 18 years. In love marriage, testimony of a priest or qazi will be required If the marriage has not taken place with the family's consent, then at the time of registration, the testimony of the pandit or qazi who performed the marriage, their affidavit, and the video recording of the marriage must be submitted on a pen drive. To prevent fraud, biometric verification of Aadhaar has also been made mandatory in marriage registration from April 1, 2026. Registration is also necessary for those having a court marriage Many times people get married in court or at Arya Samaj temple. Then wedding cards are not printed. In this situation, the bride and groom will have to get an affidavit made. This has to be uploaded in the document section at the time of registration. Without this, the form will not proceed further. When and how will the marriage certificate be received? After the online form is submitted, the Sub-Registrar office will verify it. After this, an appointment is given. On the scheduled date, the bride-groom and witnesses have to appear with their documents. Here, their signatures and thumb impressions are taken. At the time of biometric at the Tehsil, the same 2 witnesses whose documents were uploaded online will have to go. Fifteen to 30 days after this process, you can download the certificate by visiting igrsup.gov.in and entering your application number and password. This has a barcode and digital signature, which is 100 per cent valid for all government and legal work. Also know the process to correct mistakes in marriage certificate If after downloading the certificate it is found that there is a spelling mistake in the name or date of birth, it cannot be corrected online. For this, one has to go back to the same sub-registrar office and submit an application. 6 major disadvantages of not getting registration done 1. Lakhs of funds can get stuck: If something unfortunate happens to someone's husband or wife, then the marriage certificate is the biggest legal proof for claiming the PF money deposited in the partner's name, gratuity or life insurance claim. Without this, companies and banks can refuse to give the claim, or the process can take years. 2. Difficulty in becoming nominee in bank accounts and property: Banks demand a marriage certificate to make a husband or wife a nominee in property or a bank account. Without this, getting property transferred becomes difficult. 3. Risk of passport and visa rejection: If you want to travel abroad after marriage or settle overseas, getting a 'spouse visa' is impossible without a marriage certificate. It is also necessary to add your partner's name to your passport. 4. Difficulty in joint home loans and banking: If a couple wants to apply for a joint home loan, car loan, or open a joint bank account, banks ask for the marriage certificate as a primary document. 5. Unable to avail government schemes: To avail benefits of UP's mass marriage scheme or housing schemes, submitting a marriage certificate is mandatory. 6. Divorce, alimony and child custody: If any legal dispute arises in marital life in the future, the first thing to prove in court is that the marriage is legally valid. Having a marriage certificate makes this process easier.

stories.title: Damini's love story began with love at first sight:Allegedly had husband killed by snakebite for affair with driver
stories.summary: In Meerut, Damini, who had her husband bitten by a snake, once loved him immensely. Seven years ago, both of them went against their families' wishes and got married. They also had a son. Everything was going well. Then what happened that Damini had to murder Atul? A new angle has emerged from police conversations with Damini and Atul's family members and friends. This story of love, marriage and then murder begins about eight years ago in 2018. Damini's house was 3 km away from Atul's house in Hastinapur. Damini's father had passed away. Her mother and younger brother lived at home. There was also a cosmetics shop at home, which Damini herself ran. One day Atul came to her shop to buy face wash. He fell in love with Damini at first sight. Ten days later, Atul went to the shop again. He told Damini, “We belong to the same community; we are both Gurjars.” Damini replied, “Yes, I am a teacher. I work at Swami Kalyandev School. I spend some time here at the shop.” Atul said, “I also studied at the same school. I left school in 2012-13, then went to Mumbai for a job in Merchant Navy. My elder brother is also in the same field. With his help, I stayed in Merchant Navy in Mumbai. I came back here in 2015. At home, there are Papa-Mummy, my elder brother, my sister-in-law, and their three children. My second brother is also in the Navy. He has a wife, a son, and a daughter. I am still single.” “I work a computer job at a company here. I also look after Vidya Prakashan's work and also do politics. I am a co-coordinator in ABVP. I have also held a position at the Mandal level. I have also held a position in the Yuva Morcha,” Atul said. Damini replied, “You do so much work and are also a leader.” 'Atul ki Gujari' tattoo While talking and meeting each other, both became friends. One day, Atul proposed to Damini. After this, both talked to their families about marriage, but the families did not agree. However, when both insisted, the families finally agreed. They got married in Hastinapur in 2019. Atul had a private job; Damini managed the household. A year after marriage, their son Manik was born. Both also created Instagram accounts in each other's names. During this time, both Atul and Damini went to visit Meerut. To express her love, Damini got a tattoo on her left hand. She had written 'Atul ki Gurjari'. Seeing his name on Damini's hand, Atul hugged her. Atul became the school director and Damini the principal After this, both of them opened a kids' school in a rented building in Hastinapur. Damini had experience working in a school. Therefore, Atul himself took on the responsibility of director and made Damini the principal. Damini used to teach children, while Atul looked after the school's management. Later, both started a new school in another rented building, which began running well. The school had around 150 children. A year ago, Tushar entered Damini's married life It was in this school that about a year ago, in March 2025, van driver Tushar made his entry. Along with dropping children, Tushar also started picking up and dropping Damini from school to home. During this time, closeness grew between the two. Gradually, they fell in love. Meanwhile, Damini told Tushar about her husband's medical insurance of ₹20 lakh. Both thought that Damini works all day at school, and Atul handles the management. “Why not remove him from the way, and we become one. We'll take the insurance money and get married and live life happily,” this was the plan of Damini and Tushar. Atul became suspicious Seeing the actions of Damini and Tushar going to and from school together, and also going to other places together during the day, Atul became suspicious. He asked Damini, “What is going on with Tushar? Stop this right here; this is not right.” Damini replied, “There is nothing like that.” After this, Atul suspected that Damini was feeding him sleeping pills in his food. He went home and told his mother about this. He said to his mother, “Damini wants to kill me.” Mother said, “Son, you had a love marriage. Now what can I tell you? You speak to Damini.” Atul hit by an Ertiga car Tushar and Damini started planning Atul's murder. Twenty days before the murder, Atul was going somewhere on his bike when an Ertiga car hit him on the way. Atul was wearing a helmet, so he survived. Atul came home and told Damini about this incident. On this, Damini said, “When you couldn't even identify the car, what's the point of filing a complaint? It must have been some mishap that got averted. That day, Atul considered Damini's words correct and ignored the incident.” Tushar and Damini were unhappy in their marriages One day Damini said to Tushar, “How long will this go on? I am tired. Something decisive should happen in this relationship. I want to live with you.” Tushar said, “I also want to leave my wife and live with you. You are unhappy with your love marriage, and I am with my arranged marriage. We will both together build a new world.” Planned together to kill Atul Damini told Tushar, “I have a plan. If I divorce Atul, all his property will not be in my name. Why not murder him? After Atul's murder, you divorce your wife. Atul has insurance of ₹20 lakhs. We will take that money too. After that, we will get married.” “I will keep the son with me because only if he stays with me will we get the 35 bigha land in Atul's name at the in-laws' place. We will also continue running the school,” she said. After this, both of them started thinking about how to remove Atul from the way. Read in the second part how Damini and Atul together conspired to commit murder…

stories.title: Ghaziabad double murder - Sister demands death penalty for brothers:Says, 'Kill them the way they killed our parents'
stories.summary: 'It would have been better if we had no brothers at all than brothers like these. Never thought that those who used to fight among themselves would one day take the lives of mother and father. Just as they killed mom and dad, both brothers should also be killed.' This was said by the sisters of the two men who murdered their own parents on the night of 20 July (Monday) in Ghaziabad. Neighbours say that both sons together killed their own parents. To know what the two daughters are going through after the murder of their parents, a Dainik Bhaskar team reached Bhimnagar. This area is adjacent to the Delhi-Meerut Expressway. A crowd of people had gathered outside the two-story house. Policemen were standing near the gate. Sounds of women crying were coming from inside the house. When we went inside, family members' statements were being recorded in one room in the presence of police officers. Both daughters Deepika and Jyoti sitting in a corner of the room kept crying. Birthday celebration turned into mourning Ganga Saran was originally from Sathla village in Bulandshahr. However, he had been living in Bhimnagar for many years. Both his sons, Deepak (alias Vicky) and Lalit, got married during the lockdown period. However, both sons' wives had left them. Family members said both were addicted to alcohol and occasionally drove taxis. Both daughters Deepika and Jyoti are also married. On 20 July, it was the birthday of the younger son Lalit. In the evening, mother Vimlesh organised a kirtan with neighbourhood women. She made kheer-puri for her son. However, as night fell, a drinking party started at home. Family members say that around 9 PM, the parents objected to the drinking. After this, a quarrel started. Late at night, both sons attacked their father. After that, they didn't spare their mother Vimlesh either, who came to intervene. They beat both of them mercilessly, attacked them with a hammer. Then they strangled them to death. Daughter says accused brothers should be punished The elder daughter Deepika said tearfully, “Both brothers took the lives of mom and dad due to property and alcohol addiction. Both of them used to drink and create fights at home earlier too. About a year ago, they stole and sold mother's 10 tola jewellery.” “Mom and dad overlooked their mistakes every time. They tried to handle them, but in the end, those very sons killed them so mercilessly. Never even dreamed that our own brothers would become the murderers of our parents,” she said. Younger daughter Jyoti said, “Both brothers often used to drink and beat mom and dad. That's why we sisters also started coming home less. Dad educated both brothers, built a house. Got us sisters married, but both brothers never reformed. Got a call at night that the brothers had killed mom and dad.” "At first, I couldn't believe it when I heard. It felt like someone was joking. But when I reached home and saw the condition of Mom and Dad, the ground slipped from under my feet. The house where Mom and Dad's voices always echoed, there was only screaming and mourning. Even today I can't believe that the brothers whom Mom and Dad raised with so much care, they took our parents lives. Uncle says no relation with such nephews Lekhraj, the brother-in-law of Ganga Saran, came from Aligarh after hearing the news of his brother-in-law's murder. He couldn't control himself after seeing the bodies of his sister and brother-in-law. He said, “The attack on the head and face was so brutal that it was unbearable to look at. We have no relation with those who killed their own parents. They should get the death penalty or life imprisonment.” Both daughters-in-law were living separately Deepak's marriage took place on 16 May 2020, with Monica, a resident of Bulandshahr. Relatives said that Deepak used to beat his wife as well while under the influence of alcohol. He has 2 sons. Troubled by domestic quarrels and harassment, Monica had gone to her maternal home with both her sons about a year ago and has been living there since then. Younger son Lalit had a love marriage with Soni, a resident of Vijaynagar in Ghaziabad, on 25 May 2020. Lalit has no children. There used to be frequent quarrels between Lalit and his wife. Due to continuous fights, Soni had also gone to her maternal home about 40 days ago. Even after the incident of murder of her in-laws, she did not come to her in-laws' house. Additional Police Commissioner (Law and Order) said- Both the accused were caught from their home itself. During interrogation, both have confessed to murdering their parents. An FIR has been registered and both have been arrested.

stories.title: ED should take action if it finds evidence during investigation:Lucknow High Court reprimands CBI in Rahul Gandhi disproportionate assets case
stories.summary: A hearing was held on Monday in the Lucknow bench of Allahabad High Court on a petition demanding investigation into assets disproportionate to income against Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha and Raebareli MP Rahul Gandhi. The court expressed dissatisfaction with the counter affidavit filed by the CBI, stating that the progress of the investigation is not clear from it. The court directed the CBI to file a fresh affidavit from a Joint Director-level officer. The court said that the ED has taken initial action, and if new evidence is found during the investigation, it should take further action as per law. Court not satisfied with CBI's response The division bench of Justice Rajesh Singh Chauhan and Justice Brij Raj Singh said that the CBI's counter affidavit is not in accordance with the order dated May 12, 2026. The court remarked that it is not possible to understand from the filed affidavit what investigation the CBI has conducted so far on the complaint and what progress has been made. The court directed that before the next hearing, a fresh counter affidavit from a Joint Director/Head of Zone level officer of ACHQ Zone, New Delhi on behalf of CBI should be filed, containing a clear and detailed description of the progress of the investigation. Court expressed satisfaction over ED's action After reviewing the counter affidavit of the Enforcement Directorate (ED), the court said that the agency has taken necessary steps. The court stated that if any illegal activity comes to light based on evidence and documents during the investigation, ED is free to take appropriate action according to law. Central Government and other agencies given 4 weeks' time During the hearing, advocates Neerav Chitranvanshi and Amar Mani Tiwari, appearing for respondent number-6, sought time to file a detailed reply, which the court accepted and granted four weeks' time. Senior Advocate and Deputy Solicitor General of India S.B. Pandey, appearing for the Central Government on behalf of respondents number 5, 7, 8, 9 and 10, sought time to file a detailed counter affidavit. The court granted them four weeks' time as well. Two new applications by petitioner on record Petitioner S. Vignesh Shishir filed two interim applications (IA numbers-7 and 8) during the hearing. Both applications were submitted along with affidavits, which the court took on record. The court directed Deputy Solicitor General S.B. Pandey to file a response after obtaining an opinion from the concerned authorities on these applications and also inform whether the government or competent authority wishes to take any action on the petitioner's demands. Matter now 'Part-Heard', next hearing on August 20 The court said that this case has had a long hearing; therefore, on the next date it will be heard as part-heard before the same bench. For this, necessary administrative orders will be obtained from the Chief Justice. The next hearing of the case will be held in chambers in the afternoon on August 20, 2026. The High Court directed that all applications filed on Monday be assigned application numbers and then the complete record be kept in a sealed envelope in the safe custody of the Senior Registrar. What is the case? BJP member S. Vignesh Shishir filed a petition in the Lucknow bench of the Allahabad High Court demanding investigation by CBI, ED and other central agencies against Leader of Opposition in Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi for alleged disproportionate assets. Earlier on May 12, 2026, the High Court had directed CBI, ED and concerned agencies to file a progress report of preliminary investigation and counter affidavit within 8 weeks. Monday's hearing was held in compliance with that order.

stories.title: Akhilesh detained in Delhi, SP workers take to the streets:Lucknow Police drag them away; Ajay Rai detained 10 km before reaching the venue
stories.summary: SP and Congress held strong protests in Lucknow, from Tuesday evening till night. In opposition to Akhilesh Yadav's arrest in Delhi, SP workers took to the streets in Lucknow. Police dragged them from near the Vidhan Bhavan and Janbhavan and took them to Eco Garden. Earlier, Congress State President Ajay Rai, who was coming to gherao Janbhavan in support of the protest by Rahul Gandhi and other top leaders in Delhi, was detained by police about 10 kilometers away in the BKT area. He was taken to Eco Garden and released. One hour after Ajay Rai was taken into custody, Congress City Committee President Shahzad Alam and other workers reached Janbhavan and held a strong protest. During this, they had a sharp altercation with the police. Police made the protesters sit in buses and took them to Eco Garden. 4 pictures of the Congress protest First know about Congress's protest 'Rahul Gandhi is struggling in Delhi, and we are doing it in Lucknow' Congress workers demanded the resignation of PM Modi and Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan. Dr. Shahzad, who was protesting, said that this government is continuously violating the rights of students. On Monday, students were brutally lathi-charged in Delhi, and they were injured; this is extremely shameful. Our leader Rahul Gandhi is fighting this battle in Delhi, and all of us workers are struggling for students in Lucknow. 'Students' future is becoming dark' Ravi, who participated in the demonstration, said that he is a student. They have come to surround Jan Bhavan today on issues concerning students' interests. Dharmendra Pradhan should immediately resign on the issue of the NEET examination and paper leak. Due to the government's poor attitude, students' future is going into darkness. We do not want to see Dharmendra Pradhan as Education Minister under any circumstances. Our movement will not stop until he resigns. Congress leader Aryan Mishra and Congress members suddenly reached Janbhavan. While raising slogans against the BJP government and Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan, they threw ink on PM Modi's picture. Aryan said that this government has pushed students' future into darkness. That's why we are throwing ink on the picture. Playing with students' future will not be tolerated. Our leader Rahul Gandhi is continuously struggling. We are also part of the fight, he is doing. See 3 pictures of SP's protest... Now know about SP's demonstration SP State President taken into custody In protest against the detention of Samajwadi Party's National President Akhilesh Yadav in Delhi, SP workers held a massive protest demonstration in Lucknow. The party's State President Shyam Lal Pal reached the Legislative Assembly. He started raising slogans against the government. The police took him into custody from there. During this time, a large number of SP workers reached Hazratganj intersection and started raising slogans. National spokesperson Juhi Singh, Ram Singh Rana, along with a large number of workers, were taken into custody from Atal Chowk. During this, there was considerable scuffle between the workers and police, in which the protesters' clothes were torn. SP workers also demonstrated at Janbhawan Around 8:15 PM, a large number of Samajwadi Party workers reached Janbhavan. During this time, the police tried to detain them. After this, SP workers lay down on the ground. The police dragged SP leader Pooja Shukla along with all the workers and took them away in a bus. During the protest, there was considerable pushing and shoving and an altercation.
