stories.title: 'Those guilty of Ram Mandir donation theft deserve death penalty':High Court Judge's stern remark; says, 'This is moral depravity at its worst'
stories.summary: On the Ram Mandir donation theft, an Allahabad High Court judge said the incident is the height of moral depravity in Indian society. He suggested that the government should amend the law so that those accused of corruption can be awarded the death penalty. High Court Justice Atul Sreedharan made the remark while hearing a case related to bulldozer action. Justice Siddharth Nandan was also part of the bench. Justice Atul Sreedharan said: "If the Ram Mandir donation theft does not affect someone, then nothing can make that person feel ashamed. This incident reflects the height of moral depravity in our society." Justice Sreedharan said, "The average Indian has accepted corruption as normal. He does not consider it wrong unless someone is caught. India ranks 91st out of 182 countries on the Transparency list, and even that does not make us feel ashamed." Judge was hearing a bulldozer action case A bench of Justice Atul Sreedharan and Justice Siddharth Nandan of the Allahabad High Court was hearing a petition related to bulldozer action. The petition was filed by Faimuddin and others, residents of Hamirpur. The petitioners said that an FIR had been registered against their relative Afan Khan under the POCSO Act, the Uttar Pradesh Prohibition of Unlawful Religious Conversion Act, and other sections. They alleged that since then, the police and local administration, in collusion, had been targeting their properties. They sought protection of their properties from the court, arguing that action against a person's property based solely on an FIR is unjustified. However, in this case, Justice Siddharth Nandan differed from Justice Atul Sreedharan's views. As a result, the matter was referred to a third judge for hearing. Supreme Court orders fresh SIT in Ram Mandir case On 20 July, the Supreme Court ordered the formation of a fresh Special Investigation Team (SIT) in the Ayodhya Ram Mandir donation theft case. Chief Justice of India Surya Kant said, "A fresh SIT should be constituted. A senior IPS officer should lead the team so that the investigation reaches a conclusive stage." The CJI added, "We only want to issue a word of caution. Do not politicise this matter. At first glance, this appears to be an offence under criminal law. It must be investigated fairly, independently and with complete honesty. The investigation should be taken to its logical conclusion. That is all we want to say." Eight accused in jail On 7 June, former Samajwadi Party minister Pawan Pandey claimed that ₹5 crore to ₹7.5 crore had been stolen from the Ram Mandir donations. Akhilesh Yadav also questioned the government's silence and demanded a judicial probe. Champat Rai denied the allegations. As the controversy grew, BJP leader Dr Rajneesh Singh demanded a CBI investigation. On 10 June, the Prime Minister's Office (PMO) sought a report from the Ram Mandir Trust. On 25 June, trustee Krishna Mohan lodged an FIR in the donation theft case. The same day, police arrested Ram Shankar Yadav alias Tinnu, Subhash Chandra Srivastava, Manish Yadav, Anukalp Mishra, Lav Kush Mishra, Avinash Shukla, Karunesh Pandey, and Rama Shankar Mishra. All are currently lodged in Faizabad Jail. They are accused of stealing cash and jewellery while counting the temple donations. The SIT has held trustee Anil Mishra responsible for the donation theft, alleging that he was negligent in the donation-counting process and failed to follow the prescribed guidelines. Former Trust General Secretary Champat Rai and trustee Anil Mishra have resigned from their posts, and their resignations have been accepted.

stories.title: Rampur panchayat's verdict on wife's complaint:Husband to spend three days each with both wives, seventh day at his discretion
stories.summary: The Panchayat in Rampur has issued a unique decree. A young man has been divided between two wives for three days each. On the last day of the week, i.e., the weekend, the husband has been left to his will, where he can stay with whomever he wishes. This decision was announced by the Panchayat on Monday evening around 3 PM, following a complaint from the first wife. She had complained to the police about not receiving expenses. At the initiative of the police, the villagers mediated a reconciliation through the Panchayat. The case is from the Tanda police station area, about 30 km from the district headquarters. The young man had married a second time four years ago Nazaqat, a resident of Dadhiyal Nagar Panchayat, was married to Ashra from Uttarakhand 14 years ago. He has two daughters. About 4 years ago, he married Neha. He said that Ashra was not having a son. However, he also had two daughters with Neha. The husband lives with Neha. Disturbed by her husband's behaviour, the first wife filed a complaint at the police outpost on Monday. Ashra said that after the second marriage, her husband Nazaqat's behaviour changed. He lives with Neha and does not give her money for maintenance. It is becoming difficult for her to raise two daughters. Panchayat decides expenses must be given to first wife The police were gathering information about the case. Even before that, a panchayat (village council) was convened in the village. After a four hour long panchayat, the arbitrators announced their decision. The panchayat said that the young man would have to live with both wives for three days each week. One day of the week would depend on the husband's will. In addition, he would have to provide a month's ration and an expense of ₹2,000 to his first wife's house. Both parties accepted the panchayat's decision It is being said that both parties have accepted the panchayat's decision. After this, the first wife did not pursue her complaint with the police. Local police say that both parties have settled with mutual consent.

stories.title: Deoria youth killed in Russian missile strike:Father collapses after hearing the news; mother pleads, 'Please bring my son back'
stories.summary: “I had only one child. He was my precious son. No one in the family had studied. How can I forget him? Someone bring my son back...” This is what the mother of Abhishek Nishad, who lost his life in a Russian attack on Ukraine's Odesa port, said. Abhishek, a resident of Deoria, was the only son of his parents. He died on 19 July. Since her son's death, the mother has been inconsolable. To every person who comes home, the mother says the same thing, ‘someone bring my son back’. Then she faints from crying. Abhishek's father comforts his wife with one hand, and wipes his own tears with the other. The elder sister lies in a daze, not speaking even when spoken to. When the younger sister is asked about her brother, she bursts into tears. She says, “I had only one brother. Now on whose wrist will I tie a Rakhi?” Abhishek was a seaman on Turkey's 'Golden Leo' ship. The ship was carrying goods from Ukraine to Syria. On 19 July (Sunday), Abhishek died. On Monday, the shipping company's agent called and informed the family about Abhishek's death. Father got him to do a course by taking a loan Karmel village is located in the Gauri Bazar police station area. Here, Kaushal Nishad (50) lives with his family. His family includes his wife Anita Devi (45), son Abhishek Nishad (22), and two daughters Sadhana (26) and Aradhana (20). Kaushal is a farmer and also the booth president of the BJP. His elder daughter Aradhana is pursuing her MA, and the younger daughter is studying for her BA. Abhishek completed his intermediate education from Ram Prakash Mal Inter College in 2022. He wanted to join the Merchant Navy. Despite the family's poor financial condition, Kaushal fulfilled his son's dream. For this, he took a loan of ₹5,50,000. Then he sent his son for training at an institute in Lucknow. Kaushal hoped that if his son went abroad, the family's situation would improve. Reached Turkey with the dream of his sisters' marriage After completing his training, Abhishek went to Mumbai. Before leaving home, he had told his father, “Dad, now start preparing for elder sister Sadhana's wedding. I will get my sister married into a good family. I will also build a house.” From Mumbai, he reached Turkey. In Turkey, he started working as a seaman on a ship named 'Golden Leo'. He was set to receive a salary of $300 (₹28,752) every month. Food and accommodation were arranged on the ship itself. Father fainted upon hearing the news of his son's death On the night of 19 July (Sunday), Russia attacked Ukraine's Odesa port. Abhishek also died in this attack. On Monday, the shipping company's agent called Abhishek's father to inform him of his death. Upon hearing this, Abhishek's father, Kaushal, fainted. As soon as his mother and sisters learned of their son's death, they started crying loudly. Friends said they can't believe Abhishek is no more Abhishek's friend Nitish told Dainik Bhaskar, "I still can't believe that my friend is no longer in this world. He was sociable and hardworking. He was very happy after getting a job abroad. He video-called me. He was showing that there was a bombing happening there. He said, 'Brother, I am very scared.'” Abhishek's other friends also became emotional remembering the days spent with him. Meanwhile, as soon as information about the incident was received, the district administration contacted Abhishek's family. The process of bringing Abhishek's body to India through the Indian Embassy and the shipping company has been initiated. The administration states that all possible assistance will be provided to the family so that the body can reach the village soon.

stories.title: UP home guard's son held as alleged Pakistani agent:Accused of procuring explosives for a blast; father says 'punish him if guilty'
stories.summary: “If my son is guilty, he should be punished according to the law. I had no conversation with my son for the last six months. The family also had no idea that he was conspiring against the country.” This is what Home Guard Ishtiaq Ali said. UP ATS arrested Ishtiaq's son Shahroz on Monday. He is accused of spying for the Pakistani intelligence agency ISI and conspiring to carry out blasts in India. His mother said Shahroz returned to the village from Mumbai on 16 July. The next day, policemen came to the house and took her son away. Now it is known that he has been arrested. Dainik Bhaskar reached the accused's village and spoke to family members and villagers. What did ATS find out? Gangster wrote on Facebook: “Brave and courageous shooters” According to UP ATS, in October 2025, ISI agent Jasveer Chaudhary uploaded a post on Facebook writing, "Brave and courageous shooters" are needed. Shahroz commented on this post. After which, communication began between the two via Facebook Messenger, WhatsApp, and later Signal app. Jasveer Chaudhary had tasked Shahroz with procuring illegal weapons and ammunition from Sriganganagar, Rajasthan. For this, he had also sent ₹5,000 to his bank account. ATS also claims that Shahroz was in contact with Pakistani gangster Shahzad Bhatti's network. Shahroz lived with his family in Mumbai for 7 years Shahroz is a resident of Jamthara village in Balrampur. This village is about 55 km away from the district headquarters. His father, Ishtiaq Ali, is a home guard at Jarwa police station. His mother, Afroze Bano, is a homemaker. His three sisters, Arzoo Bano, Justajoo Bano and Umme Habiba, and younger brother Kaleem Danish also live with them. Mother Afroze Bano said, “Shahroz lived with his father Ishtiaq in Mumbai from 2000 to 2007. After that, the family returned to the village. Then Shahroz studied up to seventh grade in Bishanpur Tantnawa village. Later, he went to Mumbai alone and started working at a chicken meat shop. But he later returned. About 6 months ago, he went to Mumbai again and started doing his old job. He had returned to the village just four or five days ago.” Studied up to 8th grade, not married yet Shahroz had studied up to 8th grade. He is not married yet. According to the family, Shahroz returned to the village from Mumbai on July 16. The next day he went to Tulsipur, from where UP ATS took him into custody. On Monday, ATS also searched his house. Father said ATS found a foreign number in son's mobile Accused Shahroz's father, Ishtiaq Ahmed, said, “ATS officials found a foreign number in Shahroz's mobile. Shahroz had become addicted to alcohol and narcotic pills. Due to addiction, he often used to fight at home". Despite being reasoned with, his behavior did not improve, after which the family distanced themselves from him. They had not spoken to him for the past six months. He said the family never had any inkling that Shahroz could be involved in any suspicious or anti-national activity. It is possible that while living in Mumbai, he came into contact with some bad company or person. He informed that earlier he used to earn his living by working as a laborer. He also did not have any financial dealings with the family.

stories.title: Yogi targets SP with Saifai swipe:'They looted money'; says 'Babua woke up at 12 pm', Ghazi Miyan was given the 'worst death' by Maharaja Suheldev
stories.summary: CM Yogi attacked Congress and SP in Bahraich. He said- Before 2017, one family used to gobble up all the money. Somewhere the uncle, somewhere the nephew, somewhere some other relative. All the relationships of Mahabharata were there. There was a lot of looting and plundering, and a lot of anarchy spread. If someone raised their voice, then these people would occupy their house. The CM said that- In the SP government, Babuwa used to wake up at 12 noon. He would get ready at 2 o'clock. Then he would ask Chachchu what to do. Chachchu would explain to him, but he wouldn't understand anything. After that, at 5 in the evening, it would be time for him to go to the gym. After that, his gathering would be set up at night. All the schemes would be distributed right there. Yogi inaugurated and laid the foundation stone of 70 development projects worth more than ₹352 crore. He said, ''SP-Congress used to organize fairs in the name of foreign invader Ghazi Miyan. They never organized a fair in the name of Maharaja Suheldev, whereas Suheldev defeated Ghazi in battle. He gave him such a death, which is considered the biggest punishment in Islam.'' Read the key points of Yogi's speech Yogi said, ''Before 2017, farmers used to commit suicide'' Taking a dig at SP, the CM said that before 2017 farmers used to commit suicide. At that time, neither daughters were safe, nor traders. There was also a lack of basic facilities like roads, electricity and ration. There were disturbances during festivals, and development money was lost to corruption. Money was there earlier too, but the intention was not clean. One family used to grab it all. Now the benefits of schemes are reaching people directly. 15 crore poor people are getting free ration and 10 crore people are getting health insurance of up to ₹5 lakh under the Ayushman Bharat scheme. Mafia-mosquitoes under control, beware of wildlife The Chief Minister said that mafia and mosquitoes have been brought under control, but loss of life is still occurring in crocodile and leopard attacks. He gave instructions to increase patrolling in wildlife-affected areas, install doors in needy homes, and make people aware through public representatives. All public representatives, including MLAs, MPs, and Pradhans, should hold meetings and make people aware, so that no loss of life occurs.

stories.title: 127 toppers of Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith to receive medals:Convocation on July 28; Sampurnanand Sanskrit University ceremony on July 29
stories.summary: Convocation ceremonies of two different universities are going to be held in Varanasi this month. The 48th convocation ceremony of Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith will be held on 28 July at Rudraksh Convention Centre. Governor Anandiben Patel will be present here. A total of 127 meritorious students will be awarded medals in this ceremony, out of which 25 will receive them from the Governor. Preparations for this are going on at a fast pace. Public Relations Officer Nagendra Kumar Singh informed that the list of meritorious students has not been released yet. After the approval of Vice-Chancellor Prof. Bihari Lal Sharma, the examination controller released this list on the university's official website. Ravi Dixit will receive a maximum of five medals and Pushkar Tiwari will receive three medals. This time, the parents of the students will also be honoured. Registrar Rakesh Kumar informed that the list released last Saturday proposed to award a total of 54 gold medals to 32 meritorious students. Objections were invited before releasing the final list. After their resolution, the final list was released on Friday. Kainat Khanam's name was also included in the previous list, who was to be awarded one medal. Kainat's name was removed after the objections received for the list were resolved. Meanwhile, Tamanna Bano's place remains intact. Sampurnanand Sanskrit University to award medals to 20 meritorious students 1. Ravi Dixit 5 Captain Umakant Shukla Gold Medal, Dr. Nigam Sharma Gold Medal and three others. 2. Pushkar Tiwari 3 Gangamani Gold Medal, Shri Ramji Lal Shastri Gold Medal and one other. 3. Brahmachari Hanuman Chaitanya 2 medals including Shri Vivekananda Gold Medal. 4. Tamanna Bano 2 Mangniram Bagad Gold Medal, Pt. Dayashankar Dwivedi Gold Medal. 5. Govind Sampkota 2 Rishikesh Gold Medal, Jyotishacharya Examination Medal. 6. Shrikant Mishra 1 Maharaj Karan Singh Gold Medal. 7. Prabhanshu Pandey 1 Ram Pratap Shastri Gold Medal. 8. Kuchuk Artemy Vasilyevich 1 Kashiraj Bronze Medal (Foreign Student). 9. Anuradha Mishra 1 Puranetihasacharya Examination Medal. 10. Maheshmani Tripathi 1 Prachin Rajshastrarthshastracharya Examination Medal. 11. Prashant Tiwari 1 Sankhyayogatantragamacharya Examination Medal. 12. Neeraj Kumar Chaubey 1 Purvamimansacharya Examination Medal. 13. Vishakha Shukla 1 Bauddha Darshanacharya Examination Medal. 14. Nanda Siri 1 Pali Theravadacharya Examination Medal. 15. Anand Jain 1 Prakrit Jainagamacharya Examination Medal. 16. Shiv Kumar Yadav 1 Bhasha Vigyanacharya Examination Medal. 17. Aditi Pandey 1 Smt. Shashikala Sharma Gold Medal. 18. Garima 1 Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine Board Gold Medal. 19. Babli Dixit 1 Shri Mata Vaishno Devi Shrine Board Gold Medal-2016. 20. Keshav Kishore Pandey 1 Vakratunda Shukla Gold Medal.

stories.title: Farmers clash with police in Ghaziabad:Barricades breached as protesters march to Delhi against US trade deal
stories.summary: A scuffle broke out between the police and farmers in Ghaziabad on Tuesday. Around 1 pm, farmer protesters were moving towards Delhi, but the police stopped them by setting up barricades at the Ghazipur border. The farmers insisted on moving forward and started trying to remove the barricades. During this, a clash occurred between the farmers and the police. A tense atmosphere prevailed at the spot for around 20 minutes. Later, officials pacified the farmers. Farmers across the country had announced a march to Kisan Ghat in Delhi on Tuesday, in protest against the proposed trade deal between India and America. Farmers from UP were also going to Delhi to join this protest. In view of this, heavy police force was deployed at the Ghazipur border between Delhi and UP. The police were not allowing the farmers to move forward. 3 pictures of the earlier protest

stories.title: Man found dead in Gorakhpur Cantonment area:Head injuries and blood spatter seen at spot; police launch investigation
stories.summary: A 50-year-old man was found dead near the railway track beside the four-gate crossing in the Cantonment police station area of Gorakhpur, on Tuesday afternoon at around 12 o'clock. The police, who arrived upon receiving information, took possession of the body and sent it for post-mortem. To identify the body, photographs have been sent to nearby police stations. The police say that the causes of death are being investigated. According to Cantonment Police, around 12 o'clock in the afternoon, local people saw a man lying dead at some distance from the track near Mohaddeepur four-gate crossing. As soon as information was received, Cantonment Police and Government Railway Police teams reached the spot. The deceased's age is being reported as around 50 years. He was wearing a white-colored shirt. Injury marks are visible on the head. It is suspected that the person may have died by falling from a train. However, the exact cause of death can only be ascertained after the post-mortem report. Police have started efforts to identify the body. Information about missing persons has also been sought from nearby police stations and railway stations. The body has been kept in the mortuary. If identification is not done within 72 hours, proceedings for last rites will be carried out. Cantt CO Abha Singh said that CCTV footage from the incident site is being examined. People coming and going on the track are being questioned.

stories.title: Rajbhar alleges SP MP encroached on Dalit woman's land:Claims 50-bigha farmhouse built; Akhilesh's MP brother 'aware of it all'
stories.summary: UP government's Panchayati Raj Minister and Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party's National President Om Prakash Rajbhar has once again attacked Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav. Rajbhar said that he wants a strong opposition in the new government to be formed next year. If a good opposition is to be formed, then SP will have to rein in 'looter' leaders. On Tuesday morning around 11:45 AM, Rajbhar posted on X writing- Your MP has occupied 50 bighas of land belonging to a Dalit woman. He has put up electric wire all around it, so that if any poor person goes there, they may die. You should ask your brother Dharmendra Yadav. Rajbhar addressed Akhilesh Yadav as 'friend' and 'Maharaj' in his post. He has been continuously attacking SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. A day earlier too, Rajbhar had taken a dig at Akhilesh Yadav over Maulana Zarjis's statement calling Lord Krishna a Muslim. What did Minister Rajbhar write? Rajbhar wrote, “Akhilesh brother, good morning! Tell me one thing friend: Do your party people enjoy harassing the poor, backward and Dalits? In the investigations of crimes happening almost every day in the state, names of people associated with SP are coming to the fore. Why do your party people's names come up in incidents ranging from murder, hooliganism to theft and snatching?” He further wrote, "Maharaj, why have you filled the party with such people? Is this a party or a gang?" Along with this, he targeted SP MP Daroga Prasad Saroj from Lalganj, Azamgarh, calling him a 'looter'. Rajbhar said that the name may be 'Daroga' (police officer), but the work is that of looters. “You must have come to know about his scandal. Why have you made a looter named Daroga an MP?” he asked. Allegation of grabbing 50 bighas of land and 'electric wire' Rajbhar, referring to Mohanpur Patwas village in Azamgarh, alleged that the SP MP is encroaching on the land of a poor Dalit woman, Geeta Saroj. He claims that the MP has deployed his son and grandson for this purpose, who abuse and threaten people while intoxicated. He alleged that approximately 50 bighas of land and a pond have been encroached upon, where a farmhouse with a swimming pool has been constructed. Electric wires have been installed around the encroached land so that if any poor person or Dalit goes there, they may die from electrocution. Rajbhar called this a result of feudal mentality. Rajbhar told Akhilesh Yadav that if he doesn't believe in the exploits of his own party's MP, he should ask his brother Dharmendra Yadav, who knows everything. 'Take advice, otherwise you'll lose the Leader of Opposition position too' Taking a jibe, Rajbhar wrote that he wants a strong opposition in the new government to be formed next year. He said that if action is not taken against such leaders, then SP will lose even the post of Leader of Opposition. Finally, he wrote, “Jai Bharat, Jai Shri Ram, Jai Shri Krishna, Jai Maharaja Suheldev.” Rajbhar asked Akhilesh a day earlier - Are you a Yaduvanshi? A day earlier on Monday, Minister Rajbhar questioned SP chief Akhilesh Yadav's claim of being a Yaduvanshi on X. He wrote, “If Akhilesh were a true Yaduvanshi, his blood would boil over Maulana Jarjis Ansari's objectionable statements about Lord Shri Krishna.” “Maulana Jarjis is continuously making objectionable statements about our revered Lord Shri Krishna and you are cutting the nose of the entire Yaduvansh by keeping your mouth shut in the pursuit of vote bank politics. Anyway, what can be expected from you. You have fallen so low in vote bank politics that a Maulana can make indecent comments about your wife and still remain your favourite," Rajbhar said.

stories.title: Over 2,000 farmers reach commissioner's office over long-pending demands:Protesters bring hookahs to protest; dance on roads as DJs play on tractors
stories.summary: Farmers in Meerut have begun laying siege to the Collectorate over their long-pending demands. By around 12 pm on Tuesday, nearly 1,000 farmers from three tehsils had gathered outside the Commissioner's Office, causing major traffic congestion. More farmers continue to arrive in tractors, trolleys and private vehicles. In view of the protest, the main gate of the Commissioner's Office has been locked, and heavy police deployment has been made at the site. Farmer leaders said the protest would continue until the administration gives a clear assurance on their demands. Bharatiya Kisan Union (Tikait) district president Anurag Chaudhary said that despite submitting several memorandums and repeatedly raising farmers' issues during Kisan Diwas meetings, the administration has failed to resolve them. The Collectorate siege is being held in protest against this inaction. See pictures

stories.title: UP to give scooters to graduate girls:Sambhal riot report to be tabled in Assembly; Cabinet clears 18 proposals
stories.summary: The Yogi government will provide free scooters to female students who complete their graduation under the Rani Lakshmibai Scooty Scheme. The scheme is available to students from families with an annual income of less than ₹10 lakh, and only the top 5% of female students in each university and college will be eligible. The decision was approved during the Yogi Cabinet meeting on Tuesday, where 18 proposals were cleared. The government also announced that the Uttar Pradesh Legislature's monsoon session will be held from 3 to 6 August. In addition, the Cabinet approved the construction of two new expressways in the state, the Vindhya Expressway and the Vindhya–Purvanchal Link Expressway. Government to also provide helmet and 5 liters of petrol along with the scooter Higher Education Minister Yogendra Upadhyay said, The government will not only provide scooters but also their insurance, registration, helmets, essential accessories, and 5 liters of petrol. The scooters will be petrol-powered and will be purchased through the GeM portal. stories.title: UPSSSC candidates gherao Deputy CM's residence:Demand Gram Panchayat officer final results; vacancy came 4 years ago
stories.summary: Candidates for the 2022 Gram Panchayat Adhikari (Village Panchayat Officer) recruitment staged a protest in Lucknow at 9 am on Tuesday, forming a human chain outside the residence of Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak. Candidates from several districts took part, demanding the immediate release of the long-awaited final results. Protesting candidate Raghavendra Singh said applications for the 2022 recruitment were accepted in 2023, and all stages of the selection process, including the written examination and document verification, have already been completed. However, the final results are still pending. The candidates questioned the delay, saying that if all recruitment formalities have been completed, there is no reason to withhold the results. Through the Deputy Chief Minister, they urged the recruitment commission to announce the final results at the earliest. Vacancy came in 2022 Candidate Raghavendra Singh said that the vacancy came in 2022 through PET. The recruitment process for 1,468 posts of Gram Panchayat Officer started in 2023. Thousands of candidates applied for the recruitment. The written examination was also held on 27 April, 2025. The document verification process for eligible candidates was completed by April-May. Still, the final results have not been declared yet. Candidates are upset due to the delay in the results. 'Result not out even after process completion' Raghavendra said, Even after completing all the processes, the final result has not been released yet. This has created an employment crisis and challenges for livelihood for thousands of candidates. If the recruitment process had been completed on time, today we would have become the support for our families. Hundreds of such candidates always struggle even for two square meals a day. The government should complete this recruitment process as soon as possible.

stories.title: Two sons beat parents to death:Brothers were fighting; attacked couple when they tried to intervene
stories.summary: A couple was allegedly beaten to death by their two sons in Ghaziabad late on Monday night after a family dispute turned violent. The incident took place in the Crossing Republik police station area. According to police, the two brothers were arguing with each other when their parents, Gangasharan and Vimlesh, intervened to stop the fight. The sons allegedly assaulted them with their hands before attacking them with wooden sticks. A tenant, alarmed by the sound of shouting and crying, called the 112 emergency helpline to report the disturbance. Police from the Crossing Republik police station arrived at the scene and rushed the injured couple to a nearby private hospital, where both died during treatment. Senior police officer DCP Surendranath Tiwari also reached the spot. The bodies have been sent for a post-mortem examination, while both sons have been taken into custody and are being questioned. Tenant alerted police after hearing cries Police said Gangasharan lived with his wife Vimlesh and their two sons, Deepak and Lalit, in Veer Nagar. The tenant informed the emergency helpline that a prolonged argument had broken out inside the house and had turned into a violent assault. The tenant reported that Gangasharan and Vimlesh had suffered serious injuries and could be heard screaming, while cries were also coming from inside the house. Couple die during treatment When police reached the house, they found both Gangasharan and Vimlesh seriously injured, with wounds to their heads and hands and bleeding heavily. They were immediately taken to a nearby private hospital but later succumbed to their injuries. Police detained both sons soon after the incident. The exact reason behind the dispute is yet to be established, and the investigation is ongoing.

stories.title: Dimple slams 'heartless govt':Chandrashekhar continues overnight sit-in outside Parliament, says 'great oppression will bring change'
stories.summary: Uttar Pradesh MP Chandrashekhar Azad has been staging a sit-in protest against the alleged lathi-charge on protesters of the Cockroach Janata Party. He has been sitting beneath the Ambedkar statue outside Parliament since late Monday night. Even after it rained on Tuesday morning, he remained at the protest site, sitting under an umbrella. Posting on X, Azad wrote: "Whenever oppression crosses all limits, the sun of change begins to rise. The brutal treatment meted out to boys and girls at Jantar Mantar has shaken me to the core. I have not witnessed Jallianwala Bagh, but the scenes witnessed today certainly reminded me of that dark chapter in history." Meanwhile, outside Parliament, Akhilesh Yadav said: "Students and young people were lathi-charged and tear gas shells were fired. This is damaging the government's image. Doctors have told us that several students have suffered serious head injuries. Is this what Sabka Saath, Sabka Vikas means?" Dimple Yadav also criticised the government, saying: “This is a ruthless government. The children have shed so many tears, yet the government has shown no compassion. Prof. Kamil stated that candidates who have been sent a link via email should report for counselling at the designated location from 10:30 am, bringing their gate pass, one set of photocopies of their original certificates, 04 stamp-sized photographs of themselves, and an updated category certificate. Merit list uploaded on website He said that the merit list is uploaded on the university's website, and candidates can view it and download their gate pass. stories.title: Passengers jump from moving bus after tyre starts burning:Vehicle was travelling from Gorakhpur to Kushinagar
stories.summary: In Kusumi Bazar, under the AIIMS police station area of Gorakhpur, on Monday evening around 5:30 pm, smoke suddenly started rising from the tire of a contracted bus full of passengers going from Gorakhpur to Kushinagar. Seeing the smoke, panic spread among the passengers on the bus. As soon as the bus stopped, passengers started jumping out. However, a major accident was averted due to the driver's quick thinking. The bus had just reached Kusumi Bazar when people nearby saw smoke rising, raised an alarm, and informed the driver. More than 50 passengers were seated in the bus. After some time, when the situation normalised, passengers left for Kushinagar by other means. The video of this incident is also going viral on social media. As soon as the bus stopped, passengers can be seen jumping out from inside.

stories.title: Highway bus fares cut by ₹14:Expressway services to remain costlier due to toll charges
stories.summary: Traveling in roadways buses operating on the Lucknow to Kanpur highway route will now be cheaper than before. The Uttar Pradesh State Road Transport Corporation (UPSRTC) has reduced the fare for highway route buses by ₹14. The revised fare has been implemented from Tuesday. However, the fare for buses running via the expressway will remain higher than that of normal buses due to toll charges. Highway and expressway fares are different According to the corporation, the fare for buses going to Kanpur via the highway has been reduced from 137 rupees to 123 rupees. On the other hand, the fare for buses running via the expressway has been fixed at 141 rupees, which is 18 rupees more than highway buses. Buses have to pay higher toll tax on the expressway, which is why this difference in fare has been maintained. Decision taken based on toll charges Regional Manager Vimal Rajan stated that the fare has been revised due to different toll charges on highways and expressways. Buses operating on expressways are being operated from Alambagh bus stand, while new fare rates have been implemented for buses on highway routes. New fare for major stoppages from Alambagh

stories.title: 'Damini ma'am got sir killed by snakebite':Fear grips Meerut school after owner's death, students fear returning
stories.summary: 'What can I say? Just 20 days ago, I paid ₹15,000 to enrol my son at Krishna Kids School. Now Principal Damini has allegedly had her husband, school owner Atul, killed using a snake. The school has been shut for four days. I have no idea when it will reopen. My child's future is hanging in the balance.' These were the words of Avani, a resident of Meerut, while speaking to Dainik Bhaskar. Her son, Saurabh, studies at Krishna Kids School. Avani said parents have only received a message informing them that the school is closed. No further updates have been shared, and even the teachers have not provided any information. She said she had enrolled her son at the recommendation of her neighbour, school van driver Tushar, who was allegedly having an affair with Principal Damini. Meanwhile, another parent, Anita, said her daughters Bhoomi and Aparna were frightened by the incident. Speaking on camera, the girls said- "The school is closed, and we feel very sad. Madam got sir killed by a snakebite. We don't want to study there anymore. If Damini ma'am comes back to school, she might make a snake bite us too." Around 150 families whose children study at the school are now worried about their education. Many parents have already paid a year's fees in advance and are uncertain about what lies ahead. With Principal Damini in jail, Dainik Bhaskar spoke to several affected families whose children's education has been thrown into uncertainty. Parents spend up to ₹50,000, now left in Limbo Neeraj, a resident of J Block, Hastinapur, has three children studying at Krishna Kids School. His younger brother Karan said the fees for all three children had already been paid in advance. The family had also spent ₹11,000 on books and ₹5,000 on uniforms. Now, all three children are sitting at home. "We don't know whether to admit them to another school or wait for this one to reopen. We have already spent nearly ₹50,000," he said. 'Children are paying the price' Deepti and her husband Anuj, who live in Q Block, Hastinapur, near the water tank, are facing similar concerns. Anuj works in a private job to support the family. Deepti said both her sons, Piyush and Chitransh, study at Krishna Kids School. Their fees have already been paid until March, while the family has purchased ₹5,000 worth of uniforms and ₹8,000 worth of books. "Suddenly the school closed. We have no idea when it will reopen. What will happen to the money we've already paid? What about our children? We are extremely worried. Whatever happened was wrong, but it is the children who are suffering," she said. 'We've paid the fees, where do we send our children now?' Parent Rakhi said her son Shreyansh, who studies in pre-nursery, had been happily attending the school until it suddenly shut down. ‘Now the biggest concern is where to enrol him in the middle of the academic session,’ she said. Another parent, Priyanka Pal, said her son Dev, a nursery student, travelled to school by van. The family paid ₹300 per month for the van service and ₹500 per month in school fees. 'I've already paid the fees. Damini should never have done this. My son is now sitting at home, and I don't know where to send him,' she said. 'All my friends are here, I don't want another school' Rajesh Kashyap said his granddaughter Sarvi studies in LKG. He hopes the school will reopen soon under new management. 'We need good teachers, and the school should reopen quickly so our children's future is not ruined. At the moment, she's simply sitting at home.' He added that van driver Tushar used to transport Sarvi to school. The family had already paid ₹300 towards the van fee and ₹500 in school fees in advance until July. ‘We chose this school because we believed it was good. But the atmosphere has completely changed over the past few days. How can proper studies continue now?’ he said. Sarvi herself said she misses her school. "All my friends study there. I don't want to go to another school." Children fear returning to school Anita's daughters Bhoomi, a Class 1 pupil, and Aparna, who studies in Class 2, travelled to school by van. The family had already paid six months' advance van fees at ₹300 per month, along with advance school fees of ₹800 per child. Anita said the family's financial losses have been enormous. Each child received books worth around ₹6,000, while three school uniforms had also been purchased. Each uniform cost ₹1,100. "First the school announced holidays. Then we learnt that the principal had allegedly arranged for her husband, the school owner, to be killed by a snake because of her relationship with van driver Tushar. Parents are the ones who have suffered. Our children's education has been disrupted," she said. She added that switching schools midway through the academic year would create further financial pressure. "If another school agrees to admit them, we'll have to buy new uniforms, new books and pay admission fees all over again. How can ordinary parents afford that?" According to Anita, some people have claimed that Atul's elder brother, Kuldeep, may reopen the school from Monday, although nothing has been officially confirmed. She said many children are now frightened. "They keep saying that if the school reopens and Damini ma'am returns, she might get a snake to bite us too." About Krishna Kids School Atul Pawar (32) was the director of Krishna Kids School, while his wife Damini (30) served as the principal. According to police, Damini, who was allegedly in a relationship with school van driver Tushar Paila, had her husband Atul killed by a snakebite on the night of 16–17 July. The school employs eight teachers and one receptionist and has around 150 students enrolled. It caters for children from Nursery to Class 5. Monthly school fees range from ₹300 to ₹800, while the school van service costs ₹300 per month. The school operates from a rented building, and the landlord is now also concerned about receiving future rent payments. Atul and Damini had rented the premises for ₹20,000 per month.

stories.title: Boy who confronted DM dreams of becoming an IAS:Says, 'I'll help the poor'; says house remains locked
stories.summary: My mother had been very troubled for a long time. She told me that my aunt and uncle had locked our room. Seeing my mother troubled, we went to the DM. So far, there has been no solution. Now we will go to Yogiji's court. I want to become an IAS officer so that I can help troubled people like myself. This is what 13-year-old Amitabh Gupta from Lakhimpur says. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to Amitabh, who spoke fearlessly with the DM on Samadhan Diwas on 18 July, and his mother to understand their problems. There is a house in a narrow lane near the Ramjanaki temple in the Idgah locality of Sadar Kotwali. The dispute is ongoing regarding this house. Upon reaching here, it was found that Amitabh's father, Harish Gupta, is not in a good mental state. He leaves the house at any time and goes anywhere. House plaster peeled off in places The condition of the house is also not good. The plaster is peeled off in places. Amitabh and his mother, Sandhya Gupta, make newspaper envelopes and sell them to shops. The household expenses are covered by this income. Sister Khushboo studies in 11th grade, but she also helps her mother in making envelopes. We first spoke to Amitabh Reporter: Amitabh, what complaint did you take to the DM? Amitabh: Sir, my mother is very troubled. When I asked her what was wrong, she said that our uncle and aunt have taken over our house. They have put their own lock there. We went to the DM with this problem. Reporter: Had you complained anywhere before this? Amitabh: Yes sir, I had. First, my mother had gone and complained to IAS Durga Shakti Nagpal. At that time, she was the DM of our area. Reporter: Weren't you afraid to go in front of the DM? Amitabh: I wasn't afraid at all. When we are doing the right thing, there's nothing to be afraid of. People had told me that son, there's no harm in stating your case. That's why I went without fear. Reporter: Do you go to school? Amitabh: Yes sir, I absolutely do. I study in class 8. I study Civics more. Besides this, Hindi and English are also my favorite subjects. Reporter: What do you want to become when you grow up? Amitabh: Sir, I want to become an IAS Officer. Reporter: Why do you want to become an IAS officer? Amitabh: Sir, when I grow up, I want to help poor and helpless people. Many poor people like us don't get help at the right time. That's why I want to serve them by becoming an IAS officer. Reporter: Who taught you all this? Amitabh: Sir, I watch news on TV. Besides that, I keep reading my civics books. They contain many things about the country and society. That's where I learn all this. Reporter: What will be your next step now? Amitabh: Sir, we will try again by meeting with the officials. If our problem is not resolved here, we will go directly to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath ji (Yogi Darbar). Know what the mother said Sandhya Gupta said, My husband Harish Gupta's first marriage was with Aarti Gupta in the year 2000. From this marriage, they have a son named Animesh. Later, the husband and wife separated. In 2007, Harish married me for the second time. Before the marriage, I was not told that Harish had been married before. He also has a son. I found out about this after the marriage. Harish Gupta took his first son Animesh into his custody from the court. However, his upbringing is done by my sister-in-law, Neelam. He lives with her. Mother-in-law had transferred the entire house to my name Sandhya says, The ancestral house was in the name of my mother-in-law, Krishna Devi. Considering her son's mental condition and future, she transferred this house to my name during her lifetime. After this, disputes over property began among other family members. Gave two brothers their share Sandhya said, Harish has 3 brothers: Kaushal Gupta, Rajkishore, and Hariom. Rajkishore had no children. The entire house was in my name, but I still gave Kaushal and Hariom their share. I started living in the remaining part with my children. Son came to serve his sick father Sandhya said that the quarrel started when her brother-in-law and sister-in-law locked a part of the house. They claimed that this part belonged to Animesh. Animesh lives with his aunt. I have no objection to Animesh's right. If he stays with the family and takes care of his sick father and fulfills his responsibilities, then I will not object to his share. Complained many times before Sandhya said that in this matter, I complained many times to the police station, administrative officers, and the revenue department. But, no solution has been found yet. Even today, one part of the house is locked. It was with this problem that her son Amitabh reached the Samadhan Diwas (resolution day) to complain to District Magistrate Anjani Kumar Singh. Now know the whole matter On 18 July (Saturday), 13-year-old Amitabh Gupta reached the Lakhimpur Kheri District Magistrate (DM) alone during a public hearing. He told the DM that his uncle and aunt had forcibly occupied his house and locked it, and requested that it be reopened. When the station in-charge said, 'We will get it opened,' the boy replied, 'Not 'we will'... please get it opened. I shouldn't have to come here repeatedly.' As some policemen laughed, Amitabh became upset and said, ‘You people only act quickly if you get a commission.’ DM Anjani Kumar Singh told Kotwal Rajesh Kumar, Go to the child's house and get the lock opened. Kotwal Rajesh Kumar Singh immediately reached the spot. During interrogation, it was found that the room whose lock the child was talking about getting opened belonged to his father's first wife. The first wife has passed away. Her son lives in Lucknow. Since then, the child's uncle has locked the room. After this, the Kotwal returned without getting the lock opened.

stories.title: Add your name to voter list from home:Update address and photo in 5 minutes; avoid these mistakes
stories.summary: Do you want to add your name to the voter list or get a new voter card? Is your voter card made, but the name or address is incorrect? Is the photo on the card not right? All these problems can be solved from home. You don't need to visit government offices. Read how to do this Apply from home in 5 minutes To add a new name to the voter list You need to fill Form-6. You can do this in just 7 steps from your mobile or laptop- 6. Finally, enter your Aadhaar number details. After rechecking the entire form, click the 'Submit' button. 7. As soon as you submit the form, a reference ID will be generated on the screen. Note it down carefully, as this will be used to track the status of your application. What to do if your name has been removed from the voter list? Many times, people do not vote for years or leave their homes locked for a long time and go out. During verification or SIR, their name is deleted from the voter list based on the BLO's report. To become a first-time voter, being 18 years old is not the only requirement Previously, the Election Commission's rules allowed a person's name to be added to the electoral roll only if they had turned 18 by 1 January of that year. Anyone who turned 18 after 1 January had to wait until the following year to register as a voter. The Election Commission has now introduced four qualifying dates each year: 1 January, 1 April, 1 July and 1 October. Anyone who turns 18 by any of these dates can apply to be enrolled as a new voter at that time. For example, if you turn 18 on 20 June, you can apply to have your name added to the electoral roll in the same year under the 1 July qualifying date. If you make these 3 mistakes, your application may be rejected 1. Uploading unsigned documents When filling out online forms, people often upload direct photos of their Aadhaar card, mark sheet, or other documents. According to Election Commission rules, first sign the photocopy of your age or address proof, then upload it. Most applications are rejected due to unsigned documents. 2. Not selecting the correct option when changing address after marriage If a woman is transferring her Voter ID to another district or state after marriage, it is essential to select the 'Migration' option in Form-8. Along with this, attach the husband's Voter ID or marriage certificate as address proof. This ensures the record is correctly updated with the new address and husband's name. 3. Using the same mobile number for the entire family Many people register 4-5 family members using the same mobile number. This can cause problems later when downloading e-EPIC and during verification. It is better to provide a separate mobile number for each member. If that is not possible, use the head of the family's number. If you face problems getting a Voter ID, call here If you are facing any difficulty in getting a Voter ID or making corrections to it, you can call the Election Commission's toll-free helpline number 1950 from 10 AM to 5 PM. You can send an email to the official mail ID complaints@eci.gov.in. You can also seek help from your BLO (Booth Level Officer) if you wish.

stories.title: Heavy rain darkens skies in Lucknow:Canal breach in Shamli, 10 dead in 48 hours; rainfall alert across 75 districts
stories.summary: Monsoon rain and continuous downpours in the hills are worsening conditions across Uttar Pradesh. The India Meteorological Department (IMD) has issued a heavy rainfall alert across the state until 24 July, with 66 districts under warning on Tuesday. Heavy rain has been lashing Lucknow since around 7 am, while neighbouring districts remain overcast. On Monday, rain was recorded in 20 districts, including Lucknow, Kanpur, Gorakhpur, Ayodhya and Bareilly. Government hospitals in Firozabad and Unnao were flooded with knee-deep water, while a canal breach in Shamli caused a nearby road to cave in by nearly 10 feet. Continuous rainfall in the hills has also pushed up water levels in several rivers. Steps at the ghats in Varanasi and Prayagraj have gone underwater. In Varanasi, floodwater has entered the Ratneshwar Mahadev Mandir and around 40 smaller temples between Dashashwamedh and Panchganga Ghats. The Arind River is in spate in Etah, increasing the flood risk for riverside villages. Over the past 36 hours, 10 people have died due to rain-related incidents and lightning. In Muzaffarnagar, five members of a family were killed after their house collapsed. Lightning claimed two lives in Prayagraj, while one farmer each died in Ballia and Chandauli. In Etah, a woman died after the roof of her house collapsed. Lucknow meteorologist Atul Kumar Singh said, Monsoon activity has intensified after the low-pressure area over the Bay of Bengal weakened, and its impact is being felt across Uttar Pradesh. The monsoon trough currently extends from Sri Ganganagar through Rohtak, Hardoi, Varanasi and Ranchi to the north-west Bay of Bengal. As a result, an orange alert for heavy to very heavy rainfall will remain in place across the state until 24 July. This will be followed by a yellow alert for isolated heavy rainfall over the next three to four days. Weather related pictures

stories.title: RSS and government to finalise Ram Mandir CEO:5,500 candidates to be interviewed in 40 days; learn about the selection process
stories.summary: The arrangements for Ayodhya's Ram Mandir will come under the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) after 28 August (Rakshabandhan). Around 5,500 applicants from across the country have applied online for the post, and the selection committee is working to identify the most suitable candidate. A committee member said the selection is based not only on an applicant's experience but also on their faith in Lord Ram, which is a key factor in the selection process. Applicants include retired IAS and IPS officers, academicians, IT professionals, lawyers, former judges, and retired finance and accounting officers. The committee aims to complete the selection process within the next 40 days. Criteria set for selecting the CEO of Ram Mandir The Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust had invited applications for the CEO post on 13 July. Applications were accepted until 18 July. 3 conditions were laid down- What kind of people are applying for the CEO position? Committee members say, People from among the renowned personalities across the country are coming forward. Most people want to serve through the CEO position of the Ram Mandir. Because this will be a Mandir management structure that can be presented as an example in the future. This is why strict criteria have been set for the scrutiny of applications. Former bureaucrats and judges may be given preference. Talking on the phone, then calling for an interview After receiving online applications, candidates are being contacted via telephone. Their experience is being understood. Then, applicants who seem suitable based on the trust's parameters are being called for an interview. During the interview, panel members ask questions considering their qualifications. Discussions are held regarding religious faith and management methods. Since this entire process is taking place after an incident of tampering with the Ram Mandir's offerings has come to light, applicants who have come for selection are also being discussed regarding the proper management of large funds. The selection committee is also trying to understand the planning of what could be better for the Mandir. In the first phase, 5000 people are being screened out. Then, out of the remaining 500 people, only 20-30 will be kept on the list. In the second phase, the selection criteria will become tougher than before. The committee will conduct an in-depth interview of these members. In this stage, the following qualifications will be primarily assessed The 3 members of the selection committee are also observing the applicant's willpower to complete this process. They are asking, 'If you are made CEO in the coming time, how will you manage?' The members of the selection committee are doing this entire process from their homes. They will only reach Ayodhya at the time of the final selection. Final selection will be under the supervision of the Centre and RSS A senior member of Shri Ram Janmabhoomi Teerth Kshetra Trust said, The final selection of the CEO for this sensitive post will be under the direct supervision of the central government and the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS). Only that person will occupy the CEO's chair who has the consent of both the government and the Sangh.Not only this, in the future, the consent of the Centre and the Sangh will play an important role in the selection of the CEO's office staff as well. New SIT has been formed, the investigation will restart In the Ayodhya Ram Mandir offering theft case, the Supreme Court has ordered the formation of a new SIT. During the hearing at 3:30 PM on July 20, Chief Justice (CJI) Suryakant said that a new SIT should be formed. A senior IPS officer should lead the team, so that the investigation reaches a decisive stage. The CJI said that the investigation should be fair and without any discrimination. The court asked Solicitor General (SG) Tushar Mehta to bring names for the SIT from the UP government. The court will now hold the next hearing on July 27. Following this, the Yogi government also issued an order for the formation of a new SIT.

stories.summary: Hamirpur News: हमीरपुर में समाजवादी पार्टी ने शहीद पार्क में चंद्रशेखर आजाद की जयंती मनाई। इस दौरान उनके योगदान को याद किया गया। कार्यक्रम में पूर्व ब्लाक प्रमुख शिवशरण सिंह यादव और अन्य नेता शामिल हुए। मौदहा कस्बे में भी उनके योगदान को सम्मानित किया गया।

stories.title: Banda News: सात माह बाद दर्ज हुई युवती के अपहरण की रिपोर्ट
stories.summary: Banda News: बांदा के तिंदवारी थाने के एक गांव में एक पिता ने अपनी 19 वर्षीय बेटी के अपहरण की रिपोर्ट दर्ज कराई है। लड़की 16 दिसंबर 2025 को सिमौनी मेला देखने गई थी और तब से लापता है। पुलिस ने चार व्यक्तियों के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज किया है।

stories.title: कैंप में किया गया सेवानिवृत्त रेलकर्मियों की समस्याओं का समाधान

stories.title: Banda News: अधिवक्ता पुत्र के साथ मारपीट, एक माह में लिखी रिपोर्ट
stories.summary: Banda News: बांदा में अधिवक्ता के बेटे अनुराग को 12 लोगों ने घेरकर बेरहमी से पीटा, मोबाइल तोड़ा। पुलिस ने शुरुआती तहरीर पर रिपोर्ट नहीं लिखी। एक माह बाद उच्चाधिकारियों के दखल पर नामजद व 11 अज्ञात हमलावरों के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज किया गया है। मामला तुलसीनगर का है।

stories.title: Hamirpur News: पति से विवाद के बाद पत्नी ने जहर खाकर जान दी
stories.summary: Hamirpur News: पति के साथ विवाद के बाद प्रीती ने जहरीला पदार्थ सेवन कर जान दी। पिता ने दामाद पर हत्या का आरोप लगाया। मृतका की पहचान जरिया थाना क्षेत्र के अमूंद गांव में हुई। प्रीती अपने दो बच्चों को छोड़ गई। शव का पोस्टमार्टम किया जा रहा है और तहरीर मिलने पर जांच होगी।

stories.title: 18 साल पुराने सड़क हादसे में ट्रक चालक बरी
stories.summary: बांदा की विशेष न्यायिक मजिस्ट्रेट अदालत ने 18 वर्ष पुराने सड़क हादसे में आरोपी ट्रक चालक कुलदीप को सबूतों के अभाव में बरी कर दिया। अभियोजन पक्ष आरोप स्थापित करने में विफल रहा, और मुख्य गवाहों के बयानों में भी विरोधाभास था। अदालत ने कहा कि शीघ्र न्याय पाना हर व्यक्ति का मौलिक अधिकार है।

stories.title: गैंगरेप का आरोपी पकड़ा, जेल भेजा
stories.summary: पुलिस ने किठौर थाना क्षेत्र में किशोरी के साथ हुई गैंगरेप की घटना के मुख्य आरोपी अनिल को गिरफ्तार किया है। जबकि दो अन्य आरोपी अभी भी फरार हैं। पीड़ित पिता की शिकायत पर चार आरोपियों के खिलाफ मामला दर्ज किया गया था। पीड़िता ने बहला-फुसलाकर घर से ले जाने की बात बताई।

stories.title: Hamirpur News: 16 दुकानों में छापे, 18 बाल श्रमिकों को कराया मुक्त
stories.summary: Hamirpur News: गुरुवार को श्रम विभाग की टीम द्वारा कस्बे में 16 दुकानों की जांच की गई। इस दौरान 18 बाल श्रमिकों को कार्यमुक्त किया गया है। दुकानदारों को नोटिस देकर चेतावनी दी गई है कि वे ऐसे बच्चों को काम पर नहीं लगाएं। टीम की कार्रवाई से दुकानदारों में हड़कंप मच गया।

stories.title: Shamli News: मोबाइल छीनने का आरोपी गिरफ्तार
stories.summary: Shamli News: कैराना में पुलिस ने मोबाइल छीनने के आरोपी को गिरफ्तार किया है। चार दिन पहले दुकानदारों से पैसे इकट्ठा करके लौट रहे गौतम की बाइक में आरोपियों ने टक्कर मारी और मोबाइल छीन लिया। आरोपी चमन को पुलिस ने छीने गए मोबाइल के साथ गिरफ्तार किया।

stories.title: ई-रिक्शा पलटने से बुजुर्ग की मौत, चार घायल
stories.summary: बांदा के कठवरिया घाटी में तेज रफ्तार ई-रिक्शा पलटने से चालक की मौत हो गई। इस हादसे में चार अन्य लोग घायल हुए हैं। चालक संतोष, अपनी पत्नी और बच्चों के साथ निमंत्रण से वापस लौट रहा था जब उसकी ई-रिक्शा का ब्रेक फेल हुआ। सभी घायलों को अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया है।

stories.title: पीड़िता बोली- न्याय न मिला तो मुख्यमंत्री से लगाउंगी गुहार
stories.summary: बांदा की एक महिला ने अपने गनर पर शादी का झांसा देकर रेप का आरोप लगाया है। महिला गनर के साथ रहने को राजी है, लेकिन गनर मना कर रहा है। महिला ने कहा कि यदि न्याय नहीं मिला, तो वह मुख्यमंत्री से गुहार लगाएगी। मामला परिवार परामर्श केंद्र में चल रहा है।

stories.title: Banda News: मारपीट मामले में तीन दोषियों को कोर्ट उठने तक की सजा व जुर्माना
stories.summary: Banda News: बांदा में विशेष न्यायिक मजिस्ट्रेट ने पांच साल पुराने मारपीट के मामले में तीन दोषियों को न्यायालय उठने तक की सजा और 800 रुपये का अर्थदंड सुनाया। आरोप आरोपितों पर पीड़ित राहुल से मारपीट करने और गाली-गलौज करने का था। अदालत ने उन्हें 'लघु अपराध' मानते हुए दंडित किया।

stories.title: कांवड़ मार्ग पर बिजली व्यवस्था को मुख्य अभियंता ने किया निरीक्षण
stories.summary: कांवड़ यात्रा को सकुशल एवं निर्बाध रूप से संपन्न कराने के लिए मुख्य अभियंता गुरजीत सिंह ने मवाना क्षेत्र के कांवड़ मार्ग का निरीक्षण किया। उन्होंने अधिकारियों को दिशा-निर्देश दिए तथा सुरक्षा से संबंधित कार्य समय पर पूर्ण करने के आदेश दिए। यात्रा के दौरान श्रद्धालुओं की सुरक्षा विभाग की सर्वोच्च प्राथमिकता है।

stories.title: सड़क हादसे की रिपोर्ट दर्ज कराई
stories.summary: दिल्ली दून हाईवे पर सात जुलाई को एक भीषण सड़क हादसे में कार चालक आशुतोष मिश्रा के खिलाफ मुकदमा दर्ज किया गया है। इस हादसे में चालक सहित तीन दोस्तों की मौत हो गई और एक साथी गंभीर रूप से घायल हुआ। कार तेज गति से चलाकर अनियंत्रित हो गई थी, जबकि अन्य दोस्त चालाकी को ठीक करने का प्रयास कर रहे थे।

stories.title: एनसीसी: 99 विद्यार्थियों ने चयन प्रक्रिया में भाग लिया
stories.summary: गोरखपुर में 44वीं यूपी बटालियन एनसीसी के तहत महाराणा प्रताप इंटर कॉलेज में पहले वर्ष के कैडेटों की नामांकन प्रक्रिया संपन्न हुई। 52 सीटों के लिए 99 विद्यार्थियों ने भाग लिया। चयन प्रक्रिया शारीरिक परीक्षण और लिखित परीक्षा पर आधारित थी। प्रधानाचार्य ने चयनित छात्रों को शुभकामनाएं दीं।

stories.title: Hamirpur News: ट्रैक्टर की हेड लाइट से नहीं दिखी सड़क, बाइक चला रहे पेंटर की मौत
stories.summary: Hamirpur News: मौदहा में एक सड़क दुर्घटना में एक पेंटर और उसके साथी गंभीर रूप से घायल हो गए। राजवीर, 27 वर्ष, ने गंभीर चोटों के बाद इलाज के दौरान कानपुर में दम तोड़ दिया। यह हादसा उस समय हुआ जब राजवीर और उसके साथी लौट रहे थे और ट्रैक्टर की तेज रोशनी से बाइक अनियंत्रित हो गई।

stories.title: Revanth questions BRS’ silence on demand for Dharmendra Pradhan’s resignation

stories.title: Shamli News: सफाई कर्मचारी को निलंबित किया
stories.summary: Shamli News: कैराना के जिला पंचायत राज अधिकारी ने कांवड़ ड्यूटी में लापरवाही और अनुपस्थिति के कारण सफाई कर्मचारी सुधीर कुमार को निलंबित कर दिया है। वहीं, राजस्थान पुलिस ने गोकशी के आरोपी की तलाश में दबिश दी, लेकिन आरोपी नहीं मिला। दोनों मामले क्षेत्र में चर्चित रहे हैं।

stories.title: Shamli News: कैराना रोड की बदहाल साइड पटरी बनी हादसों का कारण
stories.summary: Shamli News: शामली में कैराना-पानीपत मार्ग की साइड पटरी की खराब स्थिति से राहगीरों को परेशानी हो रही है। बारिश के कारण गड्ढे बन गए हैं, जिससे दुर्घटनाएँ होने का खतरा बढ़ गया है। स्थानीय लोग पीडब्ल्यूडी से स्थायी सुधार की मांग कर रहे हैं। नगर पालिका क्षेत्र में भी कई सड़कों की स्थिति खराब है।

stories.title: Shamli News: हसनपुर लुहारी में पाइपलाइन लीकेज के कारण 15 हजार आबादी पानी को तरसी
stories.summary: Shamli News: हसनपुर लुहारी में पेयजल आपूर्ति पूरी तरह से ध्वस्त हो गई है। गांव की मुख्य पाइपलाइन में लीकेज के कारण 15 हजार लोग दिनभर पानी से वंचित रहे। गर्मी में पानी की सप्लाई ठप होने से दैनिक कार्य प्रभावित हुए। ग्रामीणों ने स्थायी समाधान की मांग की है, लेकिन अस्थायी मरम्मत से समस्या खत्म नहीं हो रही।

stories.title: औरैया में जंतर-मंतर लाठीचार्ज के विरोध में छात्रों ने निकाला शांतिमार्च
stories.summary: दिल्ली के जंतर-मंतर पर छात्रों पर हुए कथित लाठीचार्ज के खिलाफ, औरैया में छात्रों ने शांतिमार्च निकाला। छात्रों ने काली पट्टी बांधकर घटना की निष्पक्ष जांच की मांग की और शिक्षा मंत्री से इस्तीफे की अपील की। प्रदर्शन के दौरान पुलिस बल तैनात रहा, लेकिन मार्च शांतिपूर्वक संपन्न हुआ।

stories.title: सपा के विरोध मार्च से पहले कमला नगर में पुलिस का पहरा
stories.summary: भाजपा विधायक पुरुषोत्तम खंडेलवाल के खिलाफ समाजवादी पार्टी द्वारा प्रस्तावित विरोध प्रदर्शन से पूर्व पुलिस ने कमला नगर क्षेत्र को छावनी बना दिया। सपा के कार्यकर्ताओं को बैरिकेडिंग कर रोकने के बाद शांत करने का प्रयास किया गया। सपा नेताओं ने विधायक पर भ्रामक पोस्ट करने का आरोप लगाया और कार्रवाई की मांग की।

stories.title: आईआईटी पहुंचना अंत नहीं, एक नई यात्रा की शुरुआत
stories.summary: आईआईटी कानपुर में ओरिएंटेशन कार्यक्रम में नवप्रवेशित छात्र-छात्राओं और उनके अभिभावकों के चेहरों पर गर्व और खुशी थी। प्रो. मणींद्र अग्रवाल ने छात्रों को प्रेरित करते हुए कहा कि यह एक नई यात्रा की शुरुआत है। कार्यक्रम में अकादमिक संरचना और कैम्पस जीवन की जानकारी दी गई।

stories.title: Hamirpur News: हेल्थ केयर का प्रशिक्षण प्राप्त कर रोजगार से जुड़ेंगे युवा
stories.summary: Hamirpur News: सुमेरपुर ब्लाक के पौथिया गांव में कौशल विकास सेंटर का उद्घाटन सदर विधायक डॉ. मनोज प्रजापति ने किया। केंद्र में युवाओं को हेल्थ केयर ट्रेड का नि:शुल्क प्रशिक्षण दिया जाएगा, जिससे 18 से 35 वर्ष के छात्र-छात्राओं को रोजगार के नए अवसर मिलेंगे। विधायक ने सरकार की योजनाओं के बारे में भी जानकारी दी।

stories.title: Hamirpur News: दुग्ध डेयरी मार्ग में गड्ढे ही गड्ढे, बारिश में चलना दूभर
stories.summary: Hamirpur News: भरुआ सुमेरपुर में दुग्ध डेयरी मार्ग की हालत खस्ताहाल है, जिससे स्कूली बच्चे, किसान और अन्य लोग प्रभावित हो रहे हैं। कीचड़ और गंदे पानी ने इस रास्ते को दलदल बना दिया है। स्थानीय निवासियों ने प्रशासन से मरम्मतीकरण की मांग की है। इसके अलावा, कानपुर-सागर हाईवे पर भी गड्ढों की समस्या है, जो दुर्घटनाओं का खतरा बढ़ा रही है।

stories.title: नैनो उर्वरकों के प्रयोग पर जिला सहकारी प्रशिक्षण आयोजित
stories.summary: शामली में इफको के तत्वावधान में नैनो उर्वरकों पर आधारित जिला सहकारी प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम आयोजित किया गया। अधिकारियों ने किसानों को जागरूक करते हुए नैनो उर्वरकों के उपयोग को बढ़ावा देने पर जोर दिया। मुख्य अतिथि ने नैनो उर्वरकों के लाभ और उनकी बिक्री में वृद्धि के लिए समिति सचिवों की सक्रिय भूमिका की आवश्यकता पर बल दिया।

stories.title: EU locks in oil price cap in new Russia sanctions
stories.summary: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy thanked the EU for the latest measures, saying it was "crucial to preserve our unity and keep up this pressure" on the Kremlin.

stories.title: युवक ने फांसी लगाई, भर्ती
stories.summary: बांदा के कटरा मोहल्ला में 22 वर्षीय पीयूष ने कमरे के अंदर साड़ी से फांसी लगा ली। जब वह काफी देर तक बाहर नहीं निकला, तो परिजनों ने उसे फंदे से लटकते हुआ पाया। तुरंत फंदा काटकर उसे जिला अस्पताल भर्ती कराया गया।

stories.title: ई रिक्शा पलटा, युवक घायल
stories.summary: बांदा के पचनेही गांव में 21 वर्षीय सतीश ई रिक्शा से जाते समय दुर्घटनाग्रस्त हो गए। ई रिक्शा अनियंत्रित होकर पलट गया, जिसके कारण सतीश घायल हो गए। उन्हें तत्काल जिला अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया गया है।

stories.title: Nithin Raj case: prime accused surrenders before Crime Branch, remanded
stories.summary: The Crime Branch had sought permission to re-arrest Dr. Ram after the Thalassery Principal Sessions Court ordered his release, ruling that investigators had failed to comply with the Supreme Court’s guidelines governing arrests when he was taken into custody in Karnataka

stories.title: Hamirpur News: जल निकासी को नाली खोदी, मलबा न हटने से मुश्किलें
stories.summary: Hamirpur News: हमीरपुर के वार्ड नंबर नौ में जल निकासी की समस्या बढ़ गई है। नगरपालिका ने नाली खोदने के बाद मलबा नहीं हटाया है, जिससे निवासियों को आवागमन में कठिनाइयों का सामना करना पड़ रहा है। स्थानीय निवासी घायल हो रहे हैं और गंदगी फैल रही है। सभासद प्रतिनिधि ने जल्द निर्माण कार्य का आश्वासन दिया है।

stories.title: लोकतंत्र बचाने को कांग्रेसियों ने राज्यपाल से लगाई गुहार
stories.summary: कानपुर में, कांग्रेस कमेटी के अध्यक्ष संदीप शुक्ला ने अधिवक्ताओं और वरिष्ठ नेताओं के साथ जिलाधिकारी आवास पर राज्यपाल को ज्ञापन सौंपा। ज्ञापन में विपक्ष के नेताओं को हाउस अरेस्ट करके उनकी स्वतंत्रता का हनन करने का आरोप लगाया गया है। इस दौरान कई प्रमुख कांग्रेस नेता उपस्थित रहे।

stories.title: Agra News: घर में घुसकर महिला से दुष्कर्म का किया प्रयास मुकदमा
stories.summary: Agra News: सदर क्षेत्र की एक महिला ने दुराचार और फर्जी वीडियो के आधार पर बदनाम करने के लिए मामला दर्ज कराया है। आरोपी असरफ पर नशे का आदी होने और महिला के 6 वर्षीय बेटे को जान से मारने की कोशिश करने का आरोप है। पुलिस जांच कर रही है ताकि पीड़िता और उसके परिवार को सुरक्षा मिल सके।

stories.title: एक ही मामले में दो विपरीत आदेश देने पर हाई कोर्ट सख्त, यूपी सरकार की कार्रवाई पर जताया असंतोष
stories.summary: इलाहाबाद हाईकोर्ट ने देवरिया के तत्कालीन उपजिलाधिकारी (एसडीएम) द्वारा एक ही राजस्व वाद में एक ही तारीख को दो परस्पर विरोधी आदेश पारित किए जाने के मामले में उत्तर प्रदेश सरकार की कार्रवाई पर गंभीर असंतोष जताया है।

stories.title: Banda News: सांप ने दो लोगों को डसा, बिगड़ी हालत
stories.summary: Banda News: बांदा के अलीगंज में, 20 वर्षीय तालिब सफीक और 19 वर्षीय काजल को साँप ने डँसा। दोनों की हालत गंभीर होने पर परिजनों ने उन्हें जिला अस्पताल में भर्ती कराया। घटना से इलाके में भय का माहौल है।

stories.title: 25 जुलाई को शामली ब्लॉक में लगेगा मोटराइज्ड ट्राईसाइकिल पंजीकरण शिविर
stories.summary: शामली में 25 जुलाई को दिव्यांगजनों के लिए मोटराइज्ड ट्राईसाइकिल के परीक्षण एवं पंजीकरण शिविर का आयोजन होगा। इस शिविर में पात्र दिव्यांगजन भाग ले सकते हैं। 80 प्रतिशत से अधिक दिव्यांगता होने और पिछले पांच वर्षों में ट्राइसाइकिल न मिलने वाले दिव्यांगजन पंजीकरण करा सकते हैं।

stories.title: बूथ से लेकर स्ट्रांग रूम तक मतों की सुरक्षा को रहे तैयार
stories.summary: सपा छात्र सभा के राष्ट्रीय अध्यक्ष डॉ. इमरान ने भरुआ सुमेरपुर में पार्टी पदाधिकारियों और कार्यकर्ताओं के साथ बैठक की। उन्होंने मिशन 2027 की तैयारी की गहन समीक्षा की और आगामी विधानसभा चुनाव के लिए उम्मीदवारों के फीडबैक लिए। उन्होंने बूथ स्तर पर तैयारी को मजबूती देने की जरुरत पर जोर दिया।

stories.title: औरैया में कमलेश पाठक की नहीं हो सकी पेशी, रिमांड कार्यवाही के लिए 30 जुलाई की नई तारीख
stories.summary: औरैया में चर्चित दोहरे हत्याकांड में जेल में निरुद्ध पूर्व एमएलसी कमलेश पाठक के खिलाफ धोखाधड़ी का मामला रिमांड कार्यवाही में पुलिस बल की कमी के कारण स्थगित कर दिया गया। अब अगली सुनवाई 30 जुलाई को होगी। उनके खिलाफ इटावा निवासी मेडिकल कर्मचारी ने केस दर्ज कराया है।

stories.title: Shamli News: भाजपा का बूथ अध्यक्ष सम्मेलन आयोजित, चुनावी तैयारियों में जुटने का आह्वान
stories.summary: Shamli News: शामली के देव गार्डन में भाजपा के बूथ अध्यक्ष सम्मेलन का आयोजन हुआ। मुख्य अतिथि प्रमेन्द्र कुमार जांगड़ा ने बूथ अध्यक्षों को चुनावों की तैयारी में सक्रिय रहने का आह्वान किया। पूर्व विधायक तेजेन्द्र निर्वाल ने संगठन की मजबूती पर जोर दिया और कार्यकर्ताओं को आम जनता के बीच सक्रिय रहने के लिए प्रेरित किया।

stories.title: कबड्डी कलस्टर: रोमांचक मुकाबले जीतकर अगले दौरे में पहुंची टीमें
stories.summary: द्रोण पब्लिक स्कूल में चार दिवसीय सीबीएसई गर्ल्स कबड्डी क्लस्टर-19 प्रतियोगिता का दूसरा दिन बहुत रोमांचक रहा। विभिन्न टीमों ने शानदार प्रदर्शन किया, जिसमें मेरठ, आगरा, बागपत और गाजियाबाद की टीमें शामिल हैं। विजेताओं ने अगले दौर में स्थान बना लिया है और आगे के मुकाबले को लेकर उत्सुकता बनी हुई है।

stories.title: Hamirpur News: मृतक के परिजनों से मिलकर कर न्याय दिलाने का दिया भरोसा
stories.summary: Hamirpur News: हमीरपुर के ग्राम बंडवा में जून में वृद्ध पन्नालाल बाल्मीकि का संदिग्ध शव मिला था, परिवार हत्या का आरोप लगाते हुए पुलिस के पास रिपोर्ट दर्ज कराने की कोशिश कर रहा है। सपा सांसद प्रतिनिधि माया बाल्मीकि ने पीड़ित परिवार का दौरा किया और मदद का आश्वासन दिया।

stories.title: खुरहंड-बदौसा के बीच 120 की रफ्तार से दौड़ी स्पेशल ट्रेन
stories.summary: बांदा में गुरुवार को बदौसा-अतर्रा-खुरहंड रेलखंड पर स्पीड ट्रायल सफलतापूर्वक आयोजित किया गया। 120 किलोमीटर प्रति घंटे की गति से चलने वाली विशेष ट्रेन ने ट्रायल में सभी तकनीकी मानकों को संतोषजनक पाया। रेल अधिकारियों ने इस सफलता को झांसी-मानिकपुर रेल दोहरीकरण परियोजना का महत्वपूर्ण चरण बताया।

stories.title: Kausambi News: कलक्ट्रेट व तहसील के बाबुओं की तैनाती में किया फेरबदल
stories.summary: Kausambi News: डीएम डॉ. अमित पाल ने कलक्ट्रेट व तहसील में लंबे समय से तैनात लिपिकों की तैनाती में फेरबदल किया है। नए स्थानों पर जल्दी ज्वाइन करने का आदेश दिया गया है। लिपिकों में इस बदलाव को लेकर चिंता का माहौल है, क्योंकि उन्हें अपने मौजूदा पटल को छोड़कर जाना होगा।

stories.title: Kanpur News: आनंदेश्वर मंदिर में सावन मेले की तैयारी का लिया जायजा
stories.summary: Kanpur News: कानपुर में, एमएलसी सलिल विश्नोई ने सावन माह मेले को देखते हुए श्री आनंदेश्वर महादेव मंदिर का निरीक्षण किया। इस दौरान उन्होंने श्रद्धालुओं की सुविधा के लिए बिजली, सुरक्षा और स्वच्छता व्यवस्थाओं की जानकारी दी। मंदिर प्रशासन और गुरु मूर्ति हितेश्वर गिरी महाराज भी उपस्थित रहे।

stories.title: Banda News: बिजली व्यवस्था चरमराई, ग्रामीणों में रोष
stories.summary: Banda News: पैलानी तहसील के कालेश्वर विद्युत सब स्टेशन में बार-बार विद्युत कटौती और मशीन की खराबी से ग्रामीण बहुत परेशान हैं। भाजपा नेता महेंद्र सिंह गौतम ने कहा कि जर्जर विद्युत लाइनों और कर्मचारियों की लापरवाही के कारण स्थिति और बिगड़ गई है। ग्रामीणों ने विद्युत विभाग से नई लाइनों और पोल लगाने की मांग की है।

stories.title: Meerut News: तीन दिन से लापता युवक का शव सरकारी ट्यूबवेल में पड़ा मिला
stories.summary: Meerut News: फलावदा क्षेत्र के बड़े गांव रोड स्थित सरकारी ट्यूबवेल में तीन दिन से लापता युवक नरेश उर्फ पृथ्वी प्रजापति का शव बरामद हुआ। 20 जुलाई को शादी समारोह में जाने के बाद से वह लापता था। बच्चों ने ट्यूबवेल के अंदर युवक का सिर देखा। पुलिस ने शव को पोस्टमार्टम के लिए भेज दिया है।

stories.title: 28 जुलाई को लखनऊ में धरना देंगे कोटेदार
stories.summary: नरैनी में आल इंडिया फेयर प्राइस शॉप डीलर एसोसियेशन ने एक बैठक आयोजित की, जिसमें आगामी 28 जुलाई को लखनऊ में होने वाले पैदल मार्च की योजना बनाई गई। कोटेदारों ने अनदेखी और अन्य मांगों को लेकर असंतोष व्यक्त किया। बैठक में कई प्रमुख सदस्यों ने भाग लिया और खाद्यान्य वितरण के खिलाफ विरोध का निर्णय लिया।

stories.title: Sonbhadra News: पेपर लीक और छात्र उत्पीड़न के विरोध में सपा का प्रदर्शन

stories.title: Chandrashekhar ends protest, ex-girlfriend says ‘bluff exposed’:Accuses him of leaving students during police action, fasting after eating parathas
stories.summary: Nagina MP from Uttar Pradesh and Bhim Army chief Chandrashekhar Azad ended his protest on Thursday. He had been sitting alone in a protest at Parliament for three days against the lathi-charge on students. Activist Dr Rohini Ghavari released a video taking a dig at Chandrashekhar, saying, “The air has gone out. Fasting is not your cup of tea, you were eating parathas there.” Rohini alleged that Chandrashekhar had gone to Jantar Mantar on July 20 to take credit for the 25-day-long struggle of students. She claimed that he made controversial remarks, following which students got agitated and police later used force. She said, “If you were such a big well-wisher of the students, why did you run away? You should have stood in front of the police and faced the action. The moment I asked you to demand Home Minister Amit Shah’s resignation, you left the protest.” Rohini Ghavari is a resident of Indore, Madhya Pradesh. She claims that she was in a relationship with Chandrashekhar. She met the Bhim Army founder while studying in Switzerland. 2 pictures of Chandrashekhar's dharna... Rohini said- If you had taken lathi blows, you would have become a national leader Rohini Ghavari said that students and others had been protesting peacefully at Jantar Mantar for 20-25 days, but Chandrashekhar arrived there later for political gains. She alleged that during the protest, he made statements that provoked students, leading to a tense situation. She claimed that when police took action, the MP left instead of standing with the students. According to her, if Chandrashekhar was genuinely concerned about students, he should have stood with them during the police action and stepped forward for their protection. She further alleged that his intention behind joining the protest was only to gain political benefit and take credit for the movement. Rohini said, “I am not making this video to troll you. I am only making you aware of your reality that whatever you are doing is not right. You were removed from the Jantar Mantar protest. Now you are saying that ‘I was never part of that protest, I was away from it.’ Because those people will not allow you to stand there after seeing that violence broke out because of you.” She added, “Imagine what the scene would have been if an MP was taking lathis while trying to protect students. You would have become a national leader that very day and people would have praised you. But you do not have that courage. You came only to take unnecessary credit.” “Hard work like this is not possible for you. Who knows you better than yourself? I can identify what a person is capable of by looking into their eyes,” she said. ... Rohini Had Given a Challenge Had Said - Demand Home Minister Amit Shah's Resignation Rohini Ghavari had challenged MP Chandrashekhar on Thursday morning, saying, “If you are such a well-wisher of students, I have one demand. The police personnel who lathi-charged them come under Delhi Police, which works under Home Minister Amit Shah. So why don’t you demand his resignation?” She said, “If you do this, I will genuinely appreciate that you have courage. Demand the Education Minister’s resignation, and now demand the Home Minister’s resignation too. Stop this drama. I want to see how you leave the protest and who comes to remove you.” Know who is Rohini Ghavri, what is the dispute with Chandrashekhar? Dr Rohini Ghavari belongs to Indore, Madhya Pradesh. She got an opportunity to study in Switzerland under a fellowship scheme of the Madhya Pradesh government. She completed her PhD there and founded an NGO named ‘Janpower’. She currently lives in Switzerland. According to Rohini, Chandrashekhar hid the fact that he was married and allegedly exploited her by promising marriage. She claims that after he became an MP from Nagina, he started distancing himself from her. Rohini had also filed a complaint against Chandrashekhar with the Women’s Commission, but no action was taken. On the other hand, Chandrashekhar and his supporters have filed an FIR against Rohini. She has been running a campaign against him on social media for the past one year. Know about the Jantar Mantar incident... Cockroach Janata Party supporters' Parliament march, lathi-charge The supporters of Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) organised a march from Jantar Mantar to Parliament on Monday, July 20. During the protest, which continued from 8 am to 5 pm, several clashes took place between protesters and police. The protest began at 8 am, and around 10 am, protesters broke barricades and marched towards Parliament. The protesters moved from Jantar Mantar through Parliament Street, Janpath crossing, War Memorial, Kartavya Path and Vijay Chowk before reaching near Parliament. When protesters attempted to enter Parliament, security was increased and the main gate was closed. Police used tear gas shells. Later in the evening, visuals of stone-pelting also surfaced. More than 50 police personnel and an equal number of protesters were injured. CJP alleged that police used lathi-charge and tear gas against unarmed protesters. Pictures of several injured people emerged during the action. Police cleared Jantar Mantar by 5 pm. However, around 11 pm, CJP supporters returned to Jantar Mantar and resumed their protest.
